safi-cedvel:41-41.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (هاجروا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (في الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (هاجروا), on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "in the way of Allah", or "in raising the word of Allah"; (من بعد a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (هاجروا) [Translator's note: the closing parenthesis after «من بعد» is missing in the source]; (ما) a maṣdar-forming (verbal-noun) particle; (ظلموا) a past verb in the passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (نبوّئنّهم) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative.. and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the agent is "we"; (في الدنيا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نبوّئنّ), and the sign of the genitive is the implied (muqaddar) kasra; (حسنة) a second direct object, accusative, by the verb's being made to carry the meaning of «نعطينّ» ("we shall surely give") [Note: Or in the meaning of «ننزلنّهم», i.e. "a good abode".. Abū Ḥayyān chose that it be a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, i.e. "a good settling", or that the verb means «نحسننّ إليهم حسنة» ("we shall surely do them good").]; (الواو) conjunction; (اللام) the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), for emphasis; (أجر) mubtadaʾ, nominative [Translator's note: the source spells it «مبتدا»]; (الاخرة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (أكبر) khabar (predicate), nominative; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (كانوا يعلمون) like «كانوا يظلمون» [Note: In verse (33) of this sura.].
The clause «الذين هاجروا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «هاجروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الّذين).
The clause «ظلموا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «نبوّئنّهم» has no grammatical position: the answer to an implied oath, and the implied oath clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين) [Note: According to some, the khabar is omitted, indicated by the answer of the oath.].
The clause «أجر الآخرة أكبر» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «كانوا يعلمون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يعلمون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كانوا».. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of «لو» is omitted, i.e. "if those who stayed behind from the emigration knew the measure of the reward of the emigrants, they would have joined them."

safi-cedvel:42-42.t:
* I'rab:
(الّذين) a relative, khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «هم»; (صبروا) like «هاجروا» [Note: In the preceding verse (41).]; (الواو) conjunction; (على ربّهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يتوكّلون), and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (يتوكّلون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent).
The clause «(هم) الذين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive, giving a reason.
The clause «صبروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يتوكّلون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause — or to the ṣila.

* Rhetoric:
- Reporting the past with the imperfect: it is more eloquent than reporting with the past verb. That is in the words of the Exalted «وَعَلى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ»: the apparent meaning is past, and the expression with the imperfect is to bring that wonderful image to mind, as if the listener were witnessing it.

safi-cedvel:43-44.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) negating; (أرسلنا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (من قبلك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أرسلنا).. and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (رجالا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (نوحي) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ.. and the agent is "we", for majesty; (إلى) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نوحي); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition; (اسألوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent; (أهل) direct object, accusative; (الذّكر) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (كنتم) a defective past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) is a pronoun, the noun (ism) of «كان»; (لا) negating; (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «أرسلنا..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «نوحي ...» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (رجالا).
The clause «اسألوا ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you do not know of our sending men as prophets, then ask ..."
The clause «إن كنتم لا تعلمون» has no grammatical position: parenthetical, between the preposition-phrase — «بالبيّنات» — and what it is attached to.
The clause «لا تعلمون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كنتم».. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it [Note: It is permissible for the clause «كنتم لا تعلمون» to be explicative of the implied condition in the other cases of attaching the preposition-phrase..].
(بالبيّنات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نوحي) [Note: It may be attached to an omitted naʿt of (رجالا), i.e. "men laden with the clear proofs" or "accompanied by them".. or it is attached to the verb «أرسلنا», entering into the restriction together with «رجال», i.e. "We sent none but men with the clear proofs".. It may also be attached to something omitted after «إلّا», its implied form being «أرسلناهم».]; (الواو) conjunction; (الزّبر) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «البيّنات», genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (أنزلنا الذّكر) like «أرسلنا رجالا»; (إليك) like «إليهم», attached to (أنزلنا); (اللام) of reason (taʿlīl); (تبيّن) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām, and the agent is "you"; (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تبيّن); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as direct object; (نزّل) a past verb in the passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو», and it is the referring pronoun (ʿāʾid); (إليهم) like the first, attached to (نزّل).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تبيّن ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (أنزلنا).
(الواو) conjunction; (لعلّهم) a particle resembling the verb, for hope.. and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of «لعلّ»; (يتفكّرون) like «تعلمون».
The clause «أنزلنا إليك ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «أرسلنا».
The clause «تبيّن ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «نزّل ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «لعلّهم يتفكّرون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to something implied, i.e. "so they hear that, and perhaps they will reflect".

* Morphology:
(الذّكر): it is the Noble Qur'an, and it came in the form of the maṣdar (verbal noun) because it contains admonitions and alerting for the heedless.

* Benefits:
- Exegesis of the Qur'an:
The Companions at the dawn of Islam were reluctant to plunge into explaining what was obscure among the words of the Qur'an; among this group were Abū Bakr and ʿUmar, even though ʿUmar had pointed to the poetry of the Arabs in their Jāhiliyya, and that it is the register (dīwān) of the Arabs, and that in it is the explanation of their Book. But this reluctance did not prevent a group of the Companions from rising up and making their way in explaining the rare words of the Qur'an; at the head of this group were ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbbās and ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, followed by Ibn Masʿūd and Ubayy ibn Kaʿb, al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī, Mujāhid, ʿIkrima, Qatāda and al-Suddī. Aḥmad Amīn says in his book Fajr al-Islām, in substance: these exegetes among the Companions and the Successors followed a method that can be summed up as seeking guidance from the ḥadīth of the Messenger of Allah, from the spirit of the Qur'an, and from Arabic poetry and pre-Islamic literature in general, then from the customs of the Arabs in their Jāhiliyya and the dawn of their Islam, and the events they faced, and the hostility, disputes, emigration and wars that the Messenger met.

safi-cedvel:45-47.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for reproachful interrogation; (الفاء) resumptive; (أمن) a past verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (مكروا) a past verb and its agent; (السيّئات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being its adjective, i.e. "they plotted the evil plots"; «المكرات», with fatḥa on the kāf, is the plural of «مكرة», with sukūn on the kāf, the maṣdar of single occurrence from «المكر».. It may also be a direct object of (أمن), i.e. "they felt secure from the evil punishments", and on this view the interpreted maṣdar (أن يخسف) is a badal (substitute) from it.], by the verb's being made to carry the meaning of «عملوا» ("they did"), and the sign of the accusative is the kasra; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (يخسف) an imperfect verb, accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; (الباء) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يخسف); (الأرض) direct object, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخسف) is in the position of accusative as direct object, its governor being «أمن».
(أو) a conjunction; (يأتيهم) like «يخسف» and conjoined to it, and (هم) is a pronoun, direct object; (العذاب) fāʿil, nominative; (من) a preposition; (حيث) a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (يأتيهم); (لا يشعرون) like «لا تعلمون» [Note: In verse (43) of this sura.].
The clause «أمن الذين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: Or it is conjoined by the conjunction to something implied and resumptive, i.e. "did they not reflect, so they felt secure?" — said by al-Zamakhsharī — but what we have followed keeps us away from interpretive supplying, and neither the meaning nor the rules of i'rab reject it.].
The clause «مكّروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين). [Translator's note: the source writes «مكّروا» with a shadda here; the Quranic word is «مكروا».]
The clause «يخسف بهم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «يأتيهم العذاب ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «يخسف ...».
The clause «لا يشعرون ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
(أو) like the first; (يأخذهم) like «يأتيهم»; (في تقلّبهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object, i.e. "while engaged in their going about"; (الفاء) of reason (taʿlīl); (ما) negating, operating as «ليس»; (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as the noun (ism) of «ما»; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (معجزين) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of «ما», and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «يأخذهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «يأتيهم».
The clause «ما هم بمعجزين ...» has no grammatical position: giving a reason (taʿlīliyya).
(أو يأخذهم على تخوّف) like «أو يأخذهم في تقلّبهم»; (الفاء) of reason; (إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative; (ربّكم) the noun of «إنّ», accusative.. and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; (رؤف) the khabar of «إنّ», nominative; (رحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «يأخذهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the first clause «يأخذهم».
The clause «إنّ ربّكم لرؤوف ...» has no grammatical position: giving a reason.

safi-cedvel:48-48.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for reproachful interrogation; (الواو) resumptive; (لم) a particle of negation and jussive; (يروا) an imperfect verb, jussive, and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (إلى) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يروا), by the verb's being made to carry the meaning of «ينظروا» ("they look"); (خلق) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, agent, nominative; (من شيء) a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl (circumstantial) [Note: Or a tamyīz (specification) of the relative (ما).] of the omitted referring pronoun; (يتفيّأ) an imperfect verb, nominative; (ظلاله) agent, nominative.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (عن اليمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتفيّأ) [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl of «الظلال».]; (الواو) conjunction; (الشمائل) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «اليمين», genitive; (سجّدا) a ḥāl of «الظلال», accusative; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (سجّدا); (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and it refers back to «الظلال», which have been treated as rational beings; (داخرون) khabar (predicate), nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «يروا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «خلق الله ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «يتفيّأ ظلاله» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of «شيء».
The clause «هم داخرون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

* Morphology:
(اليمين): a noun for the direction opposite to the left; its pattern is فعيل.
(داخرون): plural of «داخر», active participle of the triliteral «دخر»; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:49-50.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يسجد), which is an imperfect verb, nominative; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of «ما»; (الواو) conjunction; (ما في الأرض) like its counterpart and conjoined to it; (من دابّة) a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of settledness (ḍamīr al-istiqrār) in the ṣila [Note: Or a tamyīz (specification) of the second relative (ما).]; (الملائكة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the first relative (ما) by the wāw, nominative; (وهم لا يستكبرون): and (هم) is like the first [Note: In the preceding verse (48).]; (لا) negating; (يستكبرون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «يسجد ما في السموات» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «هم لا يستكبرون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «لا يستكبرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (هم).
(يخافون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent; (ربّهم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (من فوقهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of «ربّ» [Note: Or attached to (يخافون) on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "they fear the punishment of their Lord from above them", because punishment descends from above.], i.e. "being high above them by dominion".. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (يفعلون) like «يخافون»; (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as direct object; (يؤمرون) an imperfect verb in the passive.. and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the referring pronoun is omitted.
The clause «يخافون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the agent of «يستكبرون» [Note: Or it is a ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of the negation of arrogance.].

* Rhetoric:
(1) Predominance (taghlīb): in the words of the Exalted «وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ ما فِي السَّماواتِ وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ».
If you say: why was «من» not brought instead of «ما», giving predominance to the rational beings among the creatures over the others?
I say: because if «من» had been brought, there would have been no indication of predominance in it, and it would have covered rational beings specifically; so that which is suitable for rational beings and others was brought, intending generality. It is mentioned in Rūḥ al-Maʿānī that if we say «ما» is specific to non-rational beings, then its use here for rational beings and others is for predominance.

* Benefits:
Ibn al-Ṣāʾigh said: "He made it singular and plural with regard to the two extremes, because the shade of the morning shrinks until only a little of it remains, so it is as if it were in one direction; and in the evening it is the reverse, because it takes over all directions; so the two extremes were regarded in the verse. This is from the side of meaning. From the side of wording there is agreement in it, because «سجّدا» is plural, so the plural «الشمائل» agrees with it, being adjacent to it. So in the verse there occurred the agreement of the wording with the meaning, and the regard of both together, and that is the utmost of inimitability."

safi-cedvel:51-52.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (قال) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (تتّخذوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent; (إلهين) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative [Note: The second object is omitted, its implied form being «معبودين» ("as objects of worship"); and if the verb is made to carry the meaning of «تعبدوا» ("worship"), it has a single object.], and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ; (اثنين) a naʿt (adjective) of «إلاهين», accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ, as it is annexed to the dual [Note: Or it is a ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) by way of clarification and elucidation..]; (إنّما) a restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (إله) khabar (predicate), nominative; (واحد) a naʿt of «إله», nominative like it; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition; (إيّاي) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as the direct object of an omitted verb explained by the mentioned one, and the pronoun comes after it, i.e. «إيّاي ارهبوا»; (الفاء) redundant (zāʾida), for embellishment; (ارهبون) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent, and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and the omitted (الياء) is a pronoun, direct object.
The clause «قال الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا تتّخذوا ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by «قال» (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «هو إله واحد ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «إيّاي (ارهبوا) ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if fear reaches you, then fear Me alone and none other."
The clause «ارهبون (the mentioned one)» has no grammatical position: explicative.
(الواو) conjunction; (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a delayed mubtadaʾ; (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of «ما»; (الأرض) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «السموات» by the wāw, and genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (له الدين) like «له ما في السموات»; (واصبا) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun concealed in the khabar, i.e. "religion is established for Him, being perpetual"; (الهمزة) for interrogation of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); (الفاء) conjunction; (غير) direct object, fronted, accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (تتّقون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «له ما في السموات ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «هو إله واحد».
The clause «له الدين ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «له ما في السموات».
The clause «تتّقون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «له الدين» [Note: It is — on the view of al-Zamakhsharī — conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. "are you ignorant, so you fear other than Allah?"..].

* Morphology:
(واصبا): active participle from «وصب الشيء يصب», of the bāb «ضرب», meaning "it lasted and was firm"; its pattern is فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
(1) Precaution (iḥtirās): that is in the words of the Exalted «وَقالَ اللَّهُ لا تَتَّخِذُوا إِلهَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ إِنَّما هُوَ إِلهٌ واحِدٌ». It is well known that the number and the counted noun are not combined except beyond one and two; so they say «عندي رجال ثلاثة ونساء ثلاث» ("I have three men and three women"), because the counted noun is devoid of indicating the specific number, so if you did not accompany it with its adjective, the intended number would not be understood. As for «رجل», «امرأة», «رجلان» and «امرأتان», they are counted nouns in which there is an indication of the number, so there is no need to say «رجل واحد», «امرأة واحدة», «رجلان اثنان», «امرأتان اثنتان». As for the noble verse, the noun carrying the meaning of singularity and duality indicates two things: the genus and the specific number; so when it is intended to indicate which of the two is meant, and that what the discourse is driven toward is the number, it is accompanied by what emphasises it, thereby indicating the aim toward it and the concern with it. Do you not see that if you said «إنما هو إله» and did not emphasise it with «واحد», it would not be good, and it would be imagined that you are affirming divinity, not oneness? So precaution was necessary.
(2) Shift of person (iltifāt): in the words of the Exalted «وَإِيَّايَ فَارْهَبُونِ» there is a shift from the third person to the first person, according to the doctrine of the majority, for intensity in frightening and threatening, for frightening one who is present face to face is more effective than frightening one who is absent, especially after describing Him with oneness and divinity, which entail greatness and complete power to take revenge.

safi-cedvel:53-55.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) a relative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: It was not parsed as a conditional noun so that a verb need not be supplied after it, since the verb of the condition is not omitted except after «إن» in two places: the first in the chapter of preoccupation (ishtighāl), as in the words of the Exalted «وإن أحد من المشركين استجارك فأجره», and the second when «إن» is followed by «لا» and what precedes it indicates the condition, as in the words of the poet:
فطلّقها فلست لها بكفء ... وإلّا يعل مفرقك الحسام
(So divorce her, for you are no match for her; otherwise the sword will come down upon the parting of your hair).]; (الباء) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of «ما»; (من نعمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl (circumstantial) of the referring pronoun in the ṣila — or a tamyīz (specification) of «ما»; (الفاء) redundant (zāʾida), because «ما» resembles the conditional; (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «ما»; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to the content of the apodosis; (مسّكم) a past verb.. and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الضمير) fāʿil (agent), nominative [Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is «الضرّ», as the clause list below shows]; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (إلى) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تجأرون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «ما بكم من نعمة ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «مسّكم الضرّ ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «تجأرون ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition [Note: The coming of the preposition-phrase before it is what called for the fāʾ.. It may also be that the clause is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «أنتم», and the nominal clause is the apodosis of the non-jussive condition.].
(ثمّ إذا كشف) like «ثمّ إذا مسّكم» [Note: The adverb is attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being «أشرك بعضكم» ("some of you associate partners"), because what comes after the «إذا» of surprise does not govern what precedes it.]; (الضرّ) direct object, accusative; (عنكم) like «بكم», attached to (كشف); (إذا) of surprise (fujāʾiyya); (فريق) mubtadaʾ, nominative [Note: It may be a mubtadaʾ while indefinite because it is qualified.]; (منكم) like «بكم», attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «فريق»; (بربّهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يشركون).. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (يشركون) like «تجأرون».
The clause «كشف ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «فريق منكم.. يشركون» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. And the clause «يشركون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (فريق).
(اللام) the lām of consequence (lām al-ʿāqiba) [Note: Or the lām of reason (taʿlīl).]; (يكفروا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām, and the sign of the accusative is the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative in the position of genitive, attached to (يكفروا); (آتيناهم) a past verb and its agent.. and (هم) is the direct object.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يكفروا ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (يشركون).
(الفاء) resumptive; (تمتّعوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the agent; (الفاء) of reason (taʿlīliyya); (سوف) a particle of the future; (تعلمون) like «تجأرون».
The clause «يكفروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «آتيناهم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «تمتّعوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «سوف تعلمون» has no grammatical position: giving a reason.

* Rhetoric:
- Shift of person (iltifāt): in the words of the Exalted «فَتَمَتَّعُوا» there is a shift to direct address, to announce the utmost of displeasure.

safi-cedvel:56-59.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (يجعلون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (اللام) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يجعلون) [Note: Or attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).]; (لا) negating; (يعلمون) like «يجعلون»; (نصيبا) direct object, accusative; (من) a preposition; (ما) like the first, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (نصيبا); (رزقناهم) a past verb and its agent.. and (هم) is a pronoun, direct object; (تالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being «أقسم» ("I swear"); (اللام) the lām of the oath; (تسألنّ) an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the retention of the nūn, which has been dropped because of the succession of identical letters, and the wāw — dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents — is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis; (عن) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive, and the referring pronoun is omitted, and the clause is the ṣila. — Translator's note: the source writes «العائذ» for «العائد».]; (كنتم) a defective past verb.. and (تم) is the noun (ism) of «كان»; (تفترون) like «يجعلون».
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كنتم تفترون) is in the position of genitive by the preposition, attached to (تسألنّ).
The clause «يجعلون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يعلمون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (ما).
The clause «رزقناهم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «of the implied oath ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تسألنّ ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the oath.
The clause «كنتم تفترون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «تفترون ...» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كنتم».
(الواو) conjunction; (يجعلون لله البنات) like «يجعلون لما.. نصيبا», and the sign of the accusative of the object is the kasra; (سبحان) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunction; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the second (يجعلون), so it is conjoined to the preposition-phrase «لله».. [Note: Or a fronted khabar (predicate), and (ما يشتهون) a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject).. and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent in (يجعلون).. or resumptive.]; (ما) a relative in the position of accusative, conjoined to «البنات», the objects of «يجعلون» [Note: The meaning is: "and they assign to themselves what they desire", i.e. they choose for themselves what they desire; and the i'rab is the one given in footnote (2) of the previous page.]; (يشتهون) like «يجعلون».
The clause «يجعلون ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the (first) clause «يجعلون».
The clause «(نسبّح) سبحانه» has no grammatical position: parenthetical, of supplication [Note: It is permissible for the clause to be a ḥāl of the Name of Majesty, i.e. "they assign daughters to Allah while He is exalted above their claim" — and this is not permissible according to Ibn Hishām, because the clause is one of supplication, and it is performative (inshāʾ).].
The clause «يشتهون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
(الواو) conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (ظلّ); (بشّر) a past verb in the passive; (أحدهم) nāʾib fāʿil, nominative.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (بالأنثى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بشّر), and the sign of the genitive is the implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif; (ظلّ) a past verb — an abrogating (nāsikh) one; (وجهه) the noun of «ظلّ», nominative.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (مسودّا) the khabar of «ظلّ», accusative; (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl; (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (كظيم) khabar, nominative.
The clause «بشّر أحدهم ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ظلّ وجهه مسودّا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «هو كظيم ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
(يتوارى): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the alif, and the agent is «هو», i.e. «أحدهم»; (من القوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتوارى); (من سوء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتوارى) [Note: Two prepositions of the same wording are attached to the same verb because their meanings differ: the first is for the starting point, and the second for reason, i.e. "because of the evil of what he was given tidings of".. It may also be that the first preposition-phrase is a ḥāl of the agent of «يتوارى».]; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (بشّر) like the first; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (بشّر); (الهمزة) for interrogation; (يمسكه) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, direct object, and the agent is «هو», i.e. «أحدهم»; (على هون) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl of the object of «يمسكه»; (أم) a conjunction; (يدسّه) like «يمسكه»; (في التراب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يدسّه); (ألا) a particle of alerting; (ساء) a past verb for expressing blame, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو»; (ما) a qualified indefinite noun in the position of accusative as a tamyīz (specification) of the agent pronoun [Note: Or it is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is the agent of «ساء».]; (يحكمون) like «يجعلون».
The clause «يتوارى ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in «كظيم» [Note: Or it is a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هو», in the position of nominative.. or it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).].
The clause «بشّر ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يمسكه ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption [Note: Or it is the speech reported by an implied verb of saying, which is a ḥāl of the agent of «يتوارى», i.e. "saying to himself: shall he keep it ..."].
The clause «يدسّه ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «يمسكه».
The clause «ساء ما يحكمون» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يحكمون» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (ما).

* Morphology:
(مسودّا): an active participle — or a passive participle — of the five-letter verb «اسودّ»; its pattern is مفعلّ, with ḍamma on the mīm, shadda on the lām and fatḥa on the ʿayn; and the apparent view is that it is an active participle, because the passive participle needs a preposition.

* Benefits:
The tāʾ:
The tāʾ is of six kinds, namely:
a- «تا», a demonstrative for the feminine singular, indeclinable on the sukūn.
b- The "tāʾ of the feminine", which comes on the verb quiescent and vowelled, while on the noun it is only vowelled; and since it is for distinguishing between masculine and feminine, it does not enter adjectives specific to women, such as: «حامل» (pregnant), «حائض» (menstruating), «عانس» (spinster), «مرضع» (nursing).. etc.
c- The tāʾ of the broken plural of foreign words, such as: «صولج» and «صوالجة», «طيلسان» and «طيالسة», «صيرف» and «صيارفة».
d- The tāʾ of distinction, to distinguish the single unit from its genus, such as: «تمر» and «تمرة».
e- The tāʾ of compensation: it is the one that attaches to a noun whose first radical has been dropped, such as «زنة», whose origin is «وزن».
And the tāʾ of the oath, as it is in the verse before us. Sībawayh says: the Arabs do not use the tāʾ of the oath with anything other than "the Name of Majesty". So one does not say «تربّ الكعبة».

safi-cedvel:60-62.t:
* I'rab:
(اللام) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate); (لا) negating; (يؤمنون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (بالآخرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤمنون); (مثل) a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (السوء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (لله المثل) like «للذين مثل»; (الأعلى) a naʿt (adjective) of «المثل», nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; (الواو) conjunction; (هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (العزيز) khabar, nominative; (الحكيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «للذين ... مثل السوء» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يؤمنون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لله المثل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «هو العزيز ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «لله المثل ...».
(الواو) conjunction; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (يؤاخذ) an imperfect verb, nominative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, agent, nominative; (الناس) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (بظلمهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤاخذ), and (الباء) is causal.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (ما) negating; (ترك) a past verb, and the agent is «هو»; (على) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ترك); (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (دابّة) genitive in form, accusative in position, direct object; (الواو) conjunction; (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk); (يؤخّرهم) like «يؤاخذ»..
and (هم) is a pronoun, direct object; (إلى أجل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤخّرهم); (مسمّى) a naʿt of «أجل», genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the implied kasra on the alif; (الفاء) conjunction; (إذ) an adverb of the future containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (لا يستأخرون) [Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is «إذا» («فإذا جاء أجلهم»), as the clause list below shows]; (جاء) a past verb; (أجلهم) agent, nominative, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (لا) negating; (يستأخرون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent; (الواو) conjunction; (لا يستقدمون) like «لا يستأخرون».
The clause «يؤاخذ الله ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «ما ترك ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يؤخّرهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «يؤاخذ الله..».
The clause «جاء أجلهم ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لا يستأخرون ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of the non-jussive condition (إذا).
The clause «لا يستقدمون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «لا يستأخرون».
(الواو) conjunction; (يجعلون لله ما) like «يجعلون لله البنات» [Note: In verse (57) of this sura.]; (يكرهون) like «يستأخرون»; (الواو) conjunction; (تصف) like «يؤاخذ»; (ألسنتهم) agent, nominative..
and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الكذب) direct object, accusative; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar; (الحسنى) the delayed noun (ism) of «أنّ», accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the implied fatḥa on the alif.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ لهم الحسنى) is in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) of «الكذب» [Note: Or in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. «بأنّ لهم الحسنى», and the preposition is attached to «الكذب».].
(لا) of generic negation; (جرم) the noun of «لا», indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative [Note: See the cases of the i'rab of «لا جرم» in verses (22) of Sūrat Hūd and (23) of this sura.]; (أنّ لهم النار) like «أنّ لهم الحسنى».
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ لهم النار) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being «في أنّ لهم..», attached to the khabar of «لا».
(الواو) conjunction; (أنّ) like the first, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of «أنّ»; (مفرطون) the khabar of «أنّ», nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنهم مفرطون) is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar (أنّ لهم النار).
The clause «يجعلون ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «يؤاخذ الله».
The clause «يكرهون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «تصف ألسنتهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «يجعلون».
The clause «لا جرم أنّ ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(مفرطون): passive participle from «أفرط فلانا», i.e. "he left him"; its pattern is مفعلون, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

* Benefits:
- One of the grammarians said: the conjunctive fāʾ is for sequence and immediate succession; so if you say «جاء علي فسعيد» ("ʿAlī came, then Saʿīd"), the meaning is that ʿAlī came first and Saʿīd came after him, with no interval between their coming.
Some grammarians objected to this stipulation and said: immediate succession is not stipulated for it; rather it is for succession in the light of rational or customary convention. He gave an example of that, saying: for this reason it is correct to say «دخلت البصرة فبغداد» ("I entered Basra, then Baghdad"), even if there is a long time between entering the two. But it is understood from the speech that he passed through the stages after Basra and did not stay in any of them a stay that would take him out of the bounds of travel until he entered Baghdad.
Thus it becomes clear to us that the fāʾ is not for real immediacy. Similar to it are the words of the Exalted: «فإذا جاء أجلهم», for the coming of the term is delayed beyond immediate succession; so reflect ... !

safi-cedvel:63-64.t:
* I'rab:
(تالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being «أقسم» ("I swear"); (اللام) the lām of the oath; (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (أرسلنا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (إلى أمم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أرسلنا); (من قبلك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «أمم»..
and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) conjunction; (زيّن) a past verb; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (زيّن); (الشيطان) agent, nominative; (أعمالهم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunction; (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (وليّهم) khabar (predicate), nominative.. and (هم) is like the last; (اليوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to «وليّ» [Note: In past or present time.. And if the adverb (اليوم) indicates the future, i.e. the Day of Resurrection, then it is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «وليّهم», i.e. "being punished today".]; (الواو) conjunction; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar; (عذاب) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (أليم) a naʿt of «عذاب», nominative.
The clause «of the oath ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أرسلنا ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the oath.
The clause «زيّن لهم الشيطان» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the answer to the oath.
The clause «هو وليّهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «زيّن.. الشيطان».
The clause «لهم عذاب ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «هو وليّهم».
(الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating; (أنزلنا) like «أرسلنا»; (على) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive; (الكتاب) direct object, accusative; (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (اللام) of reason (taʿlīl); (تبيّن) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām.. and the agent is "you"; (لهم) like the first, attached to (تبيّن); (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as direct object; (اختلفوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and (الواو) is the agent; (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (اختلفوا); (الواو) conjunction; (هدى) a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), its governor omitted, its implied form being «أنزلنا» [Note: It is not permissible to conjoin (هدى) to the position of the interpreted maṣdar, because its position is genitive, and the agent differs between the verb «أنزلنا» and the interpreted maṣdar, which is why it was made genitive by the lām — unlike «هدى», whose agent agrees with the agent of the verb; so the conjunction became one of conjoining clauses. This is contrary to the view of al-Zamakhsharī, who permitted conjoining (هدى) to the position of (أن تبيّن), which is the accusative.]; (رحمة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «هدى» by the wāw, accusative; (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «رحمة»; (يؤمنون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «أنزلنا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the answer to the oath.
The clause «تبيّن ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تبيّن) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (أنزلنا).
The clause «اختلفوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «يؤمنون» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of «قوم».

safi-cedvel:65-67.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (أنزل) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is «هو»; (من السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل) [Note: Or to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ماء».]; (ماء) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الفاء) conjunction; (أحيا) like «أنزل», and the fatḥa is implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أحيا), and (الباء) is causal; (الأرض) direct object, accusative; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (أحيا); (موتها) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive.. and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative; (في) a preposition; (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ» ...
and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (اللام), the second, for emphasis; (آية) the delayed noun (ism) of «إنّ», accusative; (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, a naʿt (adjective) of «آية»; (يسمعون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «الله أنزل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أنزل ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «أحيا ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «أنزل».
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآية ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يسمعون» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of «قوم».
(الواو) conjunction; (إنّ) like the first; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the khabar of «إنّ»; (في الأنعام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the implied khabar, and (في) is causal; (لعبرة) like «لآية»; (نسقيكم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the yāʾ.. and (كم) is a pronoun, direct object, and the agent is "we", for majesty; (من) a preposition and (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (نسقيكم); (في بطونه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of «ما».. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (من بين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of (لبنا) [Note: Or to (نسقي), and «من» is for the starting point.]; (فرث) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (دم) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «فرث» by the wāw, genitive; (لبنا) a second direct object, accusative; (خالصا) a naʿt of (لبنا), accusative; (سائغا) a second naʿt, accusative; (للشاربين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (سائغا).
The clause «إنّ لكم.. لعبرة» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «الله أنزل».
The clause «نسقيكم ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
(الواو) conjunction; (من ثمرات) a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar of an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e. «ثمر» [Note: Abū Ḥayyān chose to attach it to (تتّخذون), with «منه» repeated for emphasis, and the pronoun is singular in the meaning of "the juice".. Or it is attached to (نسقيكم), mentioned or implied.. And the preposition-phrase may be conjoined to his words (في الأنعام), so it would also be a khabar of (إنّ), i.e. "indeed, in the cattle and from the fruits of the palms there is for you a lesson"..]; (النخيل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الأعناب) conjoined to «النخيل» by the wāw, genitive; (تتّخذون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent; (من) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تتّخذون); (سكرا) direct object, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (رزقا) conjoined to (سكرا), accusative; (حسنا) a naʿt of (رزقا), accusative; (إنّ في ... يعقلون) like «إنّ في ... يسمعون».
The clause «من ثمرات ... ثمر» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «الله أنزل..».
The clause «تتّخذون..» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of «ثمر» — the implied mubtadaʾ.
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآية» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «يعقلون» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of «قوم».

* Morphology:
(فرث): a noun for the eaten things partly digested in the stomach (karish); its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(لبنا): a noun for the well-known food (milk); its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(خالصا): active participle from the triliteral «خلص»; its pattern is فاعل.
(سائغا): active participle from the triliteral «ساغ»; its pattern is فاعل, and in it the weak letter is changed to a hamza because it comes after the alif of فاعل, as with every hollow weak verb.
(الشاربين): plural of «الشارب», active participle from the triliteral «شرب»; its pattern is فاعل.
(سكرا): it is originally the maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb «سكر يسكر», of the bāb «فرح»; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas; then wine, or vinegar, or juice as long as it is sweet, came to be called by it..

safi-cedvel:68-69.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (أوحى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (ربّك) fāʿil (agent), nominative.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إلى النحل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوحى); (أن) an explicative particle [Note: Or maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) governed by «أوحى», or genitive by the preposition «الباء».]; (اتّخذي) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الياء) is an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as agent; (من الجبال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اتّخذي), and (من) is partitive; (بيوتا) direct object, accusative; (الواو) conjunction in both places; (من الشجر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what the first preposition-phrase is attached to, so it is conjoined to it; (من) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to the last verb and conjoined to the first preposition-phrase; (يعرشون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «أوحى ربّك..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «اتّخذي ...» has no grammatical position: explicative.
The clause «يعرشون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
(ثمّ) a conjunction; (كلي) like «اتخذي»; (من كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كلي); (الثمرات) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الفاء) conjunction; (اسلكي) like «اتّخذي»; (سبل) direct object; (ربّك) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi; (ذللا) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (سبلا) [Note: Or of the agent of «اسلكي»..], accusative; (يخرج) an imperfect verb, nominative; (من بطونها) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يخرج), and (ها) is muḍāf ilayhi; (شراب) agent, nominative; (مختلف) a naʿt (adjective) of «شراب», nominative; (ألوانه) the agent of the active participle «مختلف», nominative..
and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar (predicate); (شفاء) a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «شفاء» [Note: Or it is the lām of strengthening (lām al-taqwiya), and the noun it governs is accusative in position as the direct object of the maṣdar «شفاء».]. (إنّ في.. يتفكّرون) like «إنّ ... يسمعون» [Note: In verse (65) of this sura.].
The clause «كلي ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «اتّخذي».
The clause «اسلكي ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «كلي».
The clause «يخرج.. شراب» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآية ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «فيه شفاء ...» is in the position of nominative as a second naʿt of «شراب».

* Morphology:
(النحل): a generic noun (ism jins), whose singular is «نحلة», pattern فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn; and the pattern of «النحل» is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Subtle point-making (tankīt): in the words of the Exalted «أَنِ اتَّخِذِي مِنَ الْجِبالِ بُيُوتاً»:
This meaning is adorned by the partitive sense of «من», attached to the taking of houses, together with the unrestricted eating; as if the Exalted had entrusted the eating to her appetites and choice and did not restrict her in it, though He restricted her concerning the houses, and she was commanded to take them in some places rather than others, because the benefit of eating, absolutely, lies in relishing what she desires of it, whereas the benefit of houses is not attained in every place. For this meaning «ثم» came in: the difference in the matter between restricting her in taking houses and leaving her unrestricted in partaking of the fruits; as you say: "observe what is lawful in what you eat, then eat whatever you wish", so «ثم» stands in between because of the difference between restriction and freedom.
2- Indefiniteness (tankīr): in the words of the Exalted «فيه شفاء». Its indefiniteness is either to magnify the healing that is in it, or because there is some healing in it; both are possible.
It is reported from the Prophet ﷺ that a man came to him and said: "My brother has a complaint in his stomach." He said: "Go and give him honey to drink." He went, then returned and said: "I gave it to him and it did not help." He said: "Go and give him honey to drink, for Allah has spoken the truth and your brother's stomach has lied." So he gave it to him, and Allah cured him and he recovered.
3- Shift of person (iltifāt): in the words of the Exalted «يخرج من بطونها شراب مختلف ألوانه» to the end of the verse: a shift from address to the third person. Had the speech continued in the first pattern, it would have been said «من بطونك» ("from your bellies"). The speech was turned here from address to the third person only for a benefit, namely that He mentioned to human beings honey, its qualities and its various colours, and informed them that there are many benefits in it for them, in order to draw their attention to it. Had He said «من بطونك», that benefit produced by third-person discourse would have been lost.

* Benefits:
- The "explicative «أن»" is the one occurring after a clause that contains the meaning of saying but not its letters; and there is disagreement among those working in the linguistic sciences as to whether in this verse it is explicative or maṣdar-forming.
The explicative «أن» is in the position of «أي» ("that is"), as in the words of the Exalted: «ما قُلْتُ لَهُمْ إِلَّا ما أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ».
Thus in the command there is the meaning of saying, and a clause came after it.

safi-cedvel:70-73.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (خلقكم) a past verb, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is «هو»; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (يتوفّاكم) like «خلقكم»; (الواو) conjunction; (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate); (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as a delayed mubtadaʾ; (يردّ) an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو», and it is the referring pronoun; (إلى أرذل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يردّ); (العمر) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (اللام) a preposition; (كي) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (لا) negating; (يعلم) an imperfect verb, accusative, and the agent is «هو»; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يعلم); (علم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (شيئا) direct object of the maṣdar «علم» [Note: And the object of «يعلم» is a latent pronoun referring to (شيئا), by way of contention (tanāzuʿ).. The reverse may be valid according to the doctrine of the Kufans.].
The interpreted maṣdar (كي لا يعلم) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (يردّ).
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — abrogating (nāsikh); (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun (ism) of «إنّ», accusative; (عليم) the khabar of «إنّ», nominative; (قدير) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «الله خلقكم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «خلقكم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «يتوفّاكم ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «خلقكم».
The clause «منكم من يردّ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumptive clause,
i.e.: "among you is one who remains sound of body until he dies, and among you is one who is returned ..."
The clause «يردّ ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «لا يعلم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (كي).
The clause «إنّ الله عليم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
(الواو) conjunction; (الله فضّل) like «الله خلقكم»; (بعضكم) direct object, accusative, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (على بعض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (فضّل); (الفاء) conjunction; (ما) negating, operating as «ليس»; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of nominative as the noun of «ما»; (فضّلوا) a past verb in the passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma..
and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (رادّي) the khabar of «ما», accusative in position, genitive in form, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ; (رزقهم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (على) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (رادّي); (ملكت) a past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine; (أيمانهم) agent, nominative.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunction; (هم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (سواء), which is the khabar, nominative; (الهمزة) for interrogation of disapproval and reproach; (الفاء) conjunction; (بنعمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يجحدون) — by its being made to carry the meaning of «يكفرون»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (يجحدون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «الله فضّل..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «إنّ الله عليم».
The clause «ما الذين فضّلوا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «الله فضّل».
The clause «فضّلوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «ملكت أيمانهم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «هم فيه سواء» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «ما الذين فضّلوا» [Note: Or it is a reason for the preceding negative clause, so it has no grammatical position.].
The clause «يجحدون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.: "they associate partners with Him, and so deny His favour" [Note: Or it is resumptive, not conjoined.].
(الواو) conjunction; (الله جعل) like «الله خلقكم»..; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (جعل) [Note: By its being made to carry the meaning of «خلق».. or attached to a second object if it means «صيّر» ("made into").]; (من أنفسكم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جعل) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl of «أزواج».].. and (كم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (أزواجا) direct object, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (جعل لكم من أزواجكم بنين) like «جعل لكم من أنفسكم أزواجا», and the sign of the accusative in «بنين» is the yāʾ, as it is annexed to the sound masculine plural; (الواو) conjunction; (حفدة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «بنين», accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (رزقكم) like «خلقكم»; (من الطيّبات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (رزقكم); (الهمزة) like the first; (الفاء) conjunction; (بالباطل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤمنون), which is like «يجحدون»; (الواو) conjunction; (بنعمة الله.. يكفرون) like «بنعمة الله يجحدون», and (هم) is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ..
The clause «الله جعل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «الله فضّل..».
The clause «جعل ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «جعل (the second)» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the (first) clause «جعل».
The clause «رزقكم ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «جعل».
The clause «يؤمنون ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.:
"do they disbelieve in Allah, whose affair is this, and believe in falsehood?.." [Note: Or it is resumptive, not conjoined.].
The clause «هم يكفرون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «يؤمنون».
The clause «يكفرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
(الواو) conjunction; (يعبدون) like «يجحدون»; (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of «ما»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (ما) a relative noun [Note: Or a qualified indefinite noun, and the clause after it is a naʿt (adjective) in the position of accusative.] in the position of accusative as direct object; (لا) negating; (يملك) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is «هو», and it is the referring pronoun; (لهم) like «لكم», attached to a ḥāl of (رزقا), which is a direct object, accusative; (من السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of (رزقا) [Note: Or attached to (رزقا) as being a maṣdar.. It may also be attached to the verb «يملك».]; (الأرض) conjoined to «السموات» by the wāw, genitive; (شيئا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, i.e.: "they do not possess any possession, neither little nor much" [Note: Or it is a direct object of the maṣdar (رزقا); al-Suyūṭī made it a badal (substitute) of (رزقا).. and al-Jamal rejected that in his gloss.]; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negating; (يستطيعون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent, and the object is omitted.
The clause «يعبدون ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «يكفرون» [Note: Or it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) of His words «أفبالباطل يؤمنون».]. The clause «لا يملك لهم رزقا..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «لا يستطيعون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.

* Morphology:
(أرذل): elative noun (ism tafḍīl) from the triliteral «رذل»; its pattern is أفعل.
(حفدة): plural of «حافد», which is one who hastens in service and is quick in obedience — and it is said: a grandchild — a noun on the pattern of the active participle; and the pattern of «حفدة» is فعلة, with two fatḥas.

* Rhetoric:
- Metonymy (kināya): in the words of the Exalted «لِكَيْ لا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْئاً» the speech is a metonymy for the extreme of forgetfulness, i.e. so that he becomes very forgetful, such that if he acquires knowledge of something, he soon forgets it and his knowledge of it vanishes within the hour. He says to you: "Who is this?" and you say: "So-and-so", and not a moment passes before he asks you about him.

* Benefits:
- «لِكَيْ لا يَعْلَمَ».
In this verse two accusative-governing particles are combined, the lām of reason and «كي»; then the negating «لا» follows them, coming between the governor and the imperfect verb it puts in the accusative. Here we note two matters:
The first: that «لا» does not block the governor from its governed word; that is why the verb «يعلم» is accusative. The second: that the governor is «كي», because it is nearer to the verb and more closely attached to it than the lām. There may be other independent views for whoever wishes to delve into the disagreements of the grammarians.

safi-cedvel:74-74.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (تضربوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تضربوا); (الأمثال) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun (ism) of «إنّ», accusative; (يعلم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is «هو»; (الواو) conjunction; (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (لا) negating; (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «لا تضربوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: Or it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you wish to liken things, then do not strike likenesses for Allah"..].
The clause «إنّ الله يعلم ...» has no grammatical position: giving a reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يعلم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ».
The clause «أنتم لا تعلمون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the reason-giving clause.
The clause «لا تعلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم).

safi-cedvel:75-76.t:
* I'rab:
(ضرب) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (مثلا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (عبدا) a badal (substitute) of (مثلا), accusative; (مملوكا) a naʿt (adjective) of (عبدا), accusative; (لا) negating; (يقدر) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is «هو»; (على شيء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يقدر); (الواو) conjunction; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, conjoined to (عبدا) [Note: Or it is a qualified indefinite noun in the position of accusative, and the clause after it is a naʿt.]; (رزقناه) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn..
and (نا) is a pronoun, agent, and (الهاء) is the direct object; (من) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the verb (رزقنا), on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "from Our presence"; (رزقا) a second direct object, accusative; (حسنا) a naʿt of «رزقا», accusative; (الفاء) conjunction; (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (ينفق) like «يقدر»; (من) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ينفق); (سرّا) a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, i.e. "secret spending".], accusative; (جهرا) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (سرّا) by the wāw, accusative; (هل) an interrogative particle; (يستوون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and (الواو) is the agent; (الحمد) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar (predicate); (بل) a particle of inception carrying the meaning of rectification (istidrāk); (أكثرهم) mubtadaʾ, nominative.. and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لا يعلمون) like «لا تعلمون»..
The clause «ضرب الله..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يقدر على شيء» is in the position of accusative as a second naʿt of (عبدا) [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of (عبدا), because it is qualified.].
The clause «رزقناه ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «هو ينفق ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «هل يستوون» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «الحمد لله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أكثرهم لا يعلمون» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يعلمون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أكثرهم).
(الواو) conjunction; (ضرب الله مثلا رجلين) like «ضرب الله مثلا عبدا», and the sign of the accusative of the badal is the yāʾ, as it is a dual; (أحدهما) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (هما) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أبكم) khabar, nominative; (يقدر على شيء) like the first [Translator's note: so in the source, without «لا»; the Quranic text is «لا يقدر على شيء», as the clause list below shows]; (الواو) conjunction; (هو) like the first; (كلّ) khabar, nominative; (على مولاه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كلّ), and the sign of the genitive is the implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (أينما) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (يأت) — or to (يوجّهه), which is an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (الهاء) is a pronoun, direct object, and the agent is «هو»; (لا) negating; (يأت) an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the weak letter, and the agent is «هو»; (بخير) a preposition and its genitive noun, and it is attached to (يأت); (هل) an interrogative particle; (يستوي) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the yāʾ, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو», i.e. the mute man; (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, tawkīd (emphasis) of the agent because of the conjunction that follows; (الواو) conjunction; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, conjoined to the latent pronoun that is the agent of «يستوي»; (يأمر) like «يقدر»; (بالعدل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأمر); (الواو) conjunction [Note: Or circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause after it is a ḥāl.]; (هو) a pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (على صراط) a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هو»; (مستقيم) a naʿt of «صراط», genitive.
The clause «ضرب الله (the second)» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the (first) clause «ضرب».
The clause «أحدهما أبكم ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption [Note: Or it is a naʿt of «رجلين» in the position of accusative, and the link is the referring pronoun «هما»..].
The clause «لا يقدر على شيء ...» is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أحدهما).
The clause «هو كلّ ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «لا يقدر».
The clause «يوجّهه ...» has no grammatical position: giving a reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لا يأت بخير ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «هل يستوي ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «يأمر بالعدل ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «هو على صراط ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.

* Morphology:
(مملوكا): passive participle from the triliteral «ملك»; its pattern is مفعول.
(كلّ): an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from «كلّ يكلّ», of the bāb «ضرب»; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn, and its meaning is "heavy" or "of no benefit".

* Benefits:
- The governing action of the maṣdar:
For the maṣdar (verbal noun) to govern as its verb governs, it is stipulated that it be able to have the verb take its place, either joined with the maṣdar-forming «أن» or with the maṣdar-forming «ما».
The governing of the maṣdar with nunation is the regular rule, because it resembles the verb more than the others, as in «أو إطعام في يوم ذي مسغبة يتيما». Next in order after the nunated one comes "the maṣdar in construct", as in «ولولا دفع الله الناس», then follows the maṣdar not in construct [Translator's note: so in the source], then at the end comes "the maṣdar made definite with «أل»", as in «ضعيف الكناية أعداءه»; «النكاية» is the maṣdar made definite with «أل», and «أعداءه» is the direct object. [Translator's note: the source writes «الكناية» in the example and «النكاية» in the explanation; the well-known verse is «ضعيف النكاية أعداءه» ("weak at harming his enemies").]
We shall speak about the noun of the maṣdar (ism al-maṣdar) and its governing in another place.

safi-cedvel:77-77.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate); (غيب) a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the kasra; (الأرض) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «السموات» by the wāw, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating, non-operative (muhmala); (أمر) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الساعة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (كلمح) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (البصر) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (أو) a conjunction; (هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (أقرب) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هو», nominative; (إنّ الله.. قدير) like «إنّ الله عليم» [Note: In verse (70) of this sura.]; (على كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قدير); (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «لله غيب ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ما أمر.. إلّا كلمح ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «هو أقرب» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the implied khabar of the mubtadaʾ «أمر الساعة».
The clause «إنّ الله ... قدير» has no grammatical position: giving a reason (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(لمح): a maṣdar (verbal noun) meaning closing the eye or opening it, from «لمح», of the bāb «فتح»; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
- Representation (tamthīl): in the words of the Exalted «وَما أَمْرُ السَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ» it is a representation of the swiftness of its coming, as it was expressed at the opening of the noble sura by "coming". Al-Zajjāj said: "He did not mean that the Hour comes in the twinkling of an eye; He only described the swiftness of the power to bring it about, because He says to a thing «كُنْ فَيَكُونُ»."

safi-cedvel:78-78.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الله أخرجكم) like «الله خلقكم» [Note: In verse 70 of this sura.]; (من بطون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أخرجكم); (أمّهاتكم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive.
And (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (لا تعلمون): its i'rab has passed [Note: In verse (74) of this sura.]; (شيئا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (جعل لكم السمع) like «جعل لكم.. أزواجا» [Note: In verse (72) of this sura, and the preposition-phrase (لكم) is attached to (جعل) by its being made to carry the meaning of «خلق».]; (الواو) conjunction in both places; (الأبصار، الأفئدة) two nouns conjoined to «السمع» by the two conjunctions, accusative; (لعلّكم) a particle resembling the verb, for hope.. and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun (ism) of «لعلّ»; (تشكرون) like «تعلمون» [Note: From verse number (74).].
The clause «الله أخرجكم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أخرجكم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الله).
The clause «لا تعلمون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object in (أخرجكم).
The clause «جعل ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «أخرجكم».
The clause «لعلّكم تشكرون» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «تشكرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of «لعلّ».

safi-cedvel:79-79.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation; (لم) a particle of negation and jussive; (يروا) an imperfect verb, jussive, and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (إلى الطير) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يروا), by its being made to carry the meaning of «ينظروا» ("they look"); (مسخّرات) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الطير», accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the kasra; (في جوّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (مسخّرات); (السماء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (ما) negating; (يمسكهنّ) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (هنّ) is an attached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلّا) a particle of restriction; (الله) the Name of Majesty, agent, nominative; (إنّ في ... يؤمنون): the i'rab of its counterpart has passed [Note: In verse (65) of this sura.].
The clause «لم يروا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ما يمسكهنّ إلّا الله ...» is in the position of accusative as a second ḥāl of «الطير» [Note: Or resumptive, with no grammatical position.].
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يؤمنون» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم».

* Morphology:
(جوّ): a noun for what is between the sky and the earth, and other things; its plural is «جواء» and «أجواء»; and the pattern of «جوّ» is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
- «مُسَخَّراتٍ»:
Definition of the sound feminine plural: "it is what is pluralised with an alif and a tāʾ that are both additional"; therefore «قضاة» and «هداة» are not sound feminine plurals, but are broken plurals, because their alif and tāʾ are not additional; likewise their tāʾ is the round tāʾ (marbūṭa), whereas the tāʾ of the feminine plural is the open tāʾ. We shall return to it later when speaking about its conditions.

safi-cedvel:80-82.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (الله جعل ... وجعل.. بيوتا) like «الله جعل لكم من أنفسكم أزواجا» [Note: In verse (72) of this sura.]; (تستخفّونها) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent), and (ها) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تستخفّونها); (ظعنكم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive.. and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (يوم إقامتكم) like «يوم ظعنكم»; (الواو) conjunction; (من أصوافها) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what (من جلود..) is attached to, so it is conjoined to it; (الواو) conjunction in the three places; (أوبارها، أشعارها) two nouns in construct with the pronoun, conjoined to «أصوافها», genitive like it; (أثاثا) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (بيوتا), accusative, i.e. "and He made from their wool.. furnishings"; (متاعا) conjoined to (أثاثا), accusative; (إلى حين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (متاعا) [Note: I.e. "an enjoyment enjoyed for a time".].
The clause «الله جعل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «الله أخرجكم» [Note: In verse (78) of this sura.].
The clause «جعل ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الله).
The clause «جعل (the second)» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the (first) clause «جعل».
The clause «تستخفّونها ...» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (بيوتا).
