(الواو) conjunction; (الله جعل.. جعل.. وجعل لكم سرابيل) like «الله جعل لكم.. أزواجا» [Note: In verse (72) of this sura.] [Translator's note: the word-by-word sequence does not separately parse «مما خلق ظلالا» and «من الجبال أكنانا», though the clause list below mentions «خلق» and its relative «ما»]; (تقيكم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ.. and (كم) is a pronoun, direct object; (الحرّ) a second direct object, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (سرابيل تقيكم بأسكم) like «سرابيل تقيكم الحرّ».. and the second (كم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الكاف) a preposition of comparison [Note: Or a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being its adjective.]; (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq whose governor is «يتمّ».. and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address; (يتمّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is «هو»; (نعمته) direct object, accusative.. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (على) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive by the preposition, attached to (يتمّ), and (الميم) is for the masculine plural; (لعلّكم تسلمون) like «لعلّكم تشكرون» [Note: In verse (78) of this sura.].
The clause «الله جعل لكم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «الله جعل لكم.. سكنا».
The clause «جعل لكم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «خلق» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «جعل لكم (the second)» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the (first) clause «جعل».
The clause «وجعل لكم (the third)» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the (first) clause «جعل», or the (second). [Translator's note: so in the source, although the first «جعل» clause was given the position of nominative above.]
The clause «تقيكم ...» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of «سرابيل».
The clause «تقيكم (the second)» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of the (second) «سرابيل».
The clause «يتمّ..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لعلّكم تسلمون ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «تسلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of «لعلّ».
(الفاء) conjunction; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (تولّوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ)..
and (الواو) is the agent; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (إنّما) a restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (عليك) like «عليكم», attached to a fronted khabar; (البلاغ) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (المبين) a naʿt of «البلاغ», nominative.
The clause «تولّوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «يتمّ..».
The clause «عليك البلاغ ...» has no grammatical position: a reason for the implied apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), i.e.: "if they turn away, then there is no blame on you"..

* Morphology:
(جلود): plural of «جلد», a non-derived (jāmid) noun for what surrounds the body; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.
(ظعنكم): maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral «ظعن»; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(إقامتكم): the regular maṣdar of the four-letter verb «أقام»; the alif before the last letter has been compensated by a tāʾ at its end, because its verb is hollow weak.
(أصواف): plural of «صوف», a non-derived noun; its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn.
(أوبار): plural of «وبر», a non-derived noun; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(أشعار): plural of «شعر», a non-derived noun; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(أثاث): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) meaning goods; its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(متاع): a non-derived noun — or a maṣdar — its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.. and see verse (36) of al-Baqara.
(أكنان): plural of «كنّ», a noun for a covering; in al-Qāmūs: «الكنّ», with kasra, is the protection and covering of everything, and «الكنّ» is the house; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.
(سرابيل): plural of «سربال», a noun for a shirt or anything worn; its pattern is فعلال, with kasra on the fāʾ.

* Benefits:
- «يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ»:
Ibn Durustawayh said: the lexicographers and most grammarians say that every word whose second letter is a guttural letter (ḥarf ḥalq) may take sukūn or fatḥa, such as «بحر», «نحر», «نهر», «شعر» and «شهر». But we find the poets freeing themselves from this rule out of poetic necessity, and vowelling, when necessary, every word whose middle is quiescent. The curious thing is that we find this licence in the dialects of entire Arab countries, among them Lebanon («اللبنان»): if they want to say «قرش», they say «قرش», and if they say «درب», they vowel the middle and say «درب», and so on with the rest of the nouns with a quiescent middle. [Translator's note: the vowel marks distinguishing the two forms of each example are not shown in the source text.] We do not know whether this is a continuation of, and influence by, the rules of the language, or whether it is the colloquial that has done its work in that.

safi-cedvel:83-83.t:
* I'rab:
(يعرفون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (نعمة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (ينكرونها) like «يعرفون».. and (ها) is a pronoun, direct object; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (أكثرهم) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative.. and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الكافرون) khabar (predicate), nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «يعرفون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ينكرونها ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أكثرهم الكافرون» is in the position of accusative as an emphasising ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of «ينكرون».

safi-cedvel:84-87.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (يوم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «اذكر» ("remember"); (نبعث) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is "we", for majesty; (من كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نبعث); (أمّة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (شهيدا) direct object, accusative; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (لا) negating; (يؤذن) an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative [Note: What the permission concerns is omitted, i.e. returning to the abode of this world, or speaking and excusing themselves..]; (اللام) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), in the position of nominative; (كفروا) a past verb and its agent; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) like the first; (هم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (يستعتبون) an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative.. and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «نبعث ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the clause of what the adverb is attached to is resumptive.
The clause «لا يؤذن ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «نبعث».
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «هم يستعتبون» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «يؤذن».
The clause «يستعتبون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
(الواو) conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to the content of the apodosis; (رأى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الّذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as agent; (ظلموا) like «كفروا»; (العذاب) direct object, accusative; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (لا يخفّف) like «لا يؤذن», and the nāʾib fāʿil is «هو», i.e. the punishment; (عنهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يخفّف); (الواو) conjunction; (لا هم ينظرون) like «لا هم يستعتبون».
The clause «رأى الذين ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ظلموا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لا يخفّف ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «هو» — i.e. the punishment — and the nominal clause has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition [Note: Because an apodosis clause made of the imperfect is not joined with the fāʾ..].
The clause «هم ينظرون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «ينظرون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
(الواو) conjunction; (إذا رأى الّذين أشركوا شركاءهم) like «إذا رأى.. العذاب»; (قالوا) like «كفروا»; (ربّنا) the one addressed (munādā), in construct, accusative.. and (نا) is muḍāf ilayhi; (ها) a particle of alerting; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (شركاء) khabar, nominative, and (نا) is like the first; (الّذين) a relative in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of «شركاء»; (كنّا) a defective past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (نا) is a pronoun, the noun (ism) of «كان»; (ندعو) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the (الواو); the agent is "we"; (من دونك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied object of «ندعو», i.e. "we call upon them besides You"..
and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunction; (ألقوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents.. and (الواو) is the agent; (إلى) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ألقوا), and it refers to the partners; (القول) direct object, accusative; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of «إنّ»; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; (كاذبون) the khabar of «إنّ», nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «رأى الذين ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أشركوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الّذين).
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «of the vocative and its answer» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by «قالوا» (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «هؤلاء شركاؤنا ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative.
The clause «كنّا ندعو ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الّذين).
The clause «ألقوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause that answers the vocative.
The clause «إنّكم لكاذبون» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the maṣdar (القول) [Note: Or it has no grammatical position: explicative.].
(الواو) conjunction; (ألقوا إلى الله.. السلم) like «ألقوا إليهم القول»; (يومئذ): «يوم» is an adverb of time, accusative, attached to the verb «ألقوا».. and (إذ) is an adverbial noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (ضلّ) a past verb; (عنهم) like the first, attached to (ضلّ); (ما) a relative noun [Note: Or it is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is the agent.], indeclinable, in the position of nominative as agent, and the referring pronoun is omitted; (كانوا) a defective past verb.. and (الواو) is the noun of «كان»; (يفترون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «ألقوا.. السلم» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «ألقوا.. القول».
The clause «ضلّ عنهم ما ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «ألقوا السلم».
The clause «كانوا يفترون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يفترون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كانوا».

safi-cedvel:88-89.t:
* I'rab:
(الّذين) a relative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (كفروا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (الواو) conjunction; (صدّوا) like «كفروا»; (عن سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (صدّوا); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (زدناهم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn..
and (نا) is a pronoun, agent, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عذابا) a second direct object, accusative; (فوق) an adverb of place, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (عذابا); (العذاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (كانوا يفسدون) like «كانوا يفترون» [Note: In the preceding verse (87).].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا يفسدون) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (زدناهم).
The clause «الّذين كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الّذين).
The clause «صدّوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «زدناهم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الّذين).
The clause «كانوا يفسدون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «يفسدون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كانوا».
(الواو) conjunction; (يوم نبعث.. شهيدا): its i'rab has passed [Note: In verse (84) of this sura.]; (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (شهيدا); (من أنفسهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of (شهيدا), and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (جئنا) like «زدنا»; (الباء) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (جئنا); (شهيدا) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the second-person pronoun, accusative; (على) a preposition; (ها) a particle of alerting; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to the second (شهيدا); (الواو) resumptive; (نزّلنا) like «زدنا»; (عليك) like «عليهم», attached to (نزّلنا); (الكتاب) direct object, accusative; (تبيانا): a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative [Note: Or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl, i.e. «مبنيّين» ... — Translator's note: so in the source; «مبيّنين» ("clarifying") is evidently meant.]; (لكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تبيانا); (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction in the three places; (هدى، رحمة، بشرى) nouns conjoined to «التبيان» by the conjunctions, accusative like it, and the sign of the accusative in «هدى» and «بشرى» is the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (للمسلمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بشرى), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «نبعث ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «جئنا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «نبعث».
The clause «نزّلنا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(تبيانا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the four-letter verb «بيّن»; it seems that there is no maṣdar on this pattern other than this one along with the maṣdar «تلقاء».. As for nouns, they are many, like «التمساح» and «التمثال».. Its pattern is تفعال, with kasra on the tāʾ.

safi-cedvel:90-90.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun (ism) of «إنّ», accusative; (يأمر) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is «هو»; (بالعدل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يأمر); (الواو) conjunction in the five places; (الإحسان، إيتاء) two nouns conjoined to «العدل», genitive; (ذي) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ; (القربى) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif; (ينهى) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the alif, and the agent is «هو»; (عن الفحشاء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينهى); (المنكر، البغي) two nouns conjoined to «الفحشاء» by the two conjunctions, genitive; (يعظكم) like «يأمر».. and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لعلّكم) a particle resembling the verb, for hope.. and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of «لعلّ»; (تذكّرون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «إنّ الله يأمر ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يأمر ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ».
The clause «ينهى ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «يأمر».
The clause «يعظكم ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of «يأمر» and «ينهى».
The clause «لعلّكم تذكّرون ...» has no grammatical position: giving a reason (taʿlīliyya) [Note: Or it has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).].
The clause «تذكّرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of «لعلّ».

* Morphology:
(إيتاء): the regular maṣdar (verbal noun) of the four-letter verb «آتى», since its pattern is أفعل; the origin of «إيتاء» is «إئتاء»: the second hamza was lightened, and the final yāʾ was changed into a hamza because a quiescent alif comes before it.

* Rhetoric:
1- This verse — as al-Bukhārī reported in al-Adab, al-Bayhaqī in Shuʿab al-Īmān, and al-Ḥākim, who declared it sound, from Ibn Masʿūd — is the most comprehensive verse for good and evil, and it was the cause of faith becoming settled in the heart of ʿUthmān ibn Maẓʿūn. More than one has said: if there were nothing in the Qur'an but this noble verse, it would suffice for its being "a clarification of everything" and guidance.
2- It in fact contains varieties of eloquence, which we explain in what follows:
a- Concision (ījāz): at the beginning of the verse He commanded every good, after that He forbade every evil, and He sealed the verse with the most eloquent of admonitions, and He framed that in the endings of the phrases.
b- Soundness of division (ṣiḥḥat al-taqsīm): in it He covered all the divisions of the meaning, so no good remains but it falls within the scope of the command, and no evil remains but it falls within the domain of the prohibition. He put the mention of justice first because it is obligatory, and followed it with excellence (iḥsān) because it is recommended, so that the arrangement of the speech would be in the best order.
c- Excellence of sequence (ḥusn al-nasaq): in the ordering of the clauses and the conjoining of some to others as is fitting, since He put justice first and conjoined excellence to it, «الإحسان» being a general noun while giving to relatives is specific, as though it were a species of that genus; then He brought the clause of command first and conjoined the clause of prohibition to it.
d- Excellence of clarity (ḥusn al-bayān): because whoever hears the wording of the verse does not hesitate in understanding its meaning, since it is free of complexity in its wording and indicates its meaning clearly by the nearest and easiest of ways, and the clever and the dull are equal in understanding it.

safi-cedvel:91-92.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (أوفوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn..
and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (بعهد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوفوا); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis; (عاهدتّم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (تم) is a pronoun, agent; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (تنقضوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn, and (الواو) is the agent; (الأيمان) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تنقضوا); (توكيدها) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.. and (ها) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl; (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (جعلتم) like «عاهدتم»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, direct object, accusative; (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (كفيلا), by its being made to carry the meaning of «شاهدا» ("witness"); (كفيلا) a second direct object, accusative; (إنّ الله بعلم) like «إنّ الله يأمر» [Note: In the preceding verse (90).] [Translator's note: so in the source («بعلم»); the Quranic text is «إنّ الله يعلم», as the clause list below shows]; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of accusative as direct object, and the clause after it is the ṣila, and the referring pronoun is omitted, i.e. «تفعلونه».]; (تفعلون) like «تذكّرون» [Note: In verse (90).].
The clause «أوفوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «عاهدتّم ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what was mentioned before it.
The clause «لا تنقضوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «جعلتم ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of «تنقضوا».. [Note: Or of the agent of the maṣdar (توكيد), even though it is omitted.].
The clause «إنّ الله يعلم ...» has no grammatical position: in the status of giving a reason.
The clause «يعلم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ».
The clause «تفعلون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (ما).
(الواو) conjunction; (لا) like the first; (تكونوا) a defective imperfect verb, jussive, and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is a pronoun, the noun (ism) of «تكون»; (الكاف) a preposition of comparison; (التي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to the khabar of «تكونوا»; (نقضت) a past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine; (غزلها) direct object, accusative.. and (ها) is muḍāf ilayhi, and the agent is «هي», the referring pronoun [Translator's note: the source has «هو»]; (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نقضت); (قوّة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (أنكاثا) a ḥāl of «غزلها», accusative [Note: On the view of al-Zajjāj it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because the meaning of «نقضت» is «نكثت», so it matches its governor in meaning.]; (تتّخذون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent; (أيمانكم) direct object, accusative.. and (كم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (دخلا) a second direct object, accusative; (بينكم) an adverb, accusative, attached to (دخلا), and (كم) is like the first; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (تكون) a defective imperfect verb, accusative; (أمّة) the noun of «تكون», nominative; (هي) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: The Basrans did not permit making (هي) a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), because (أمّة) is indefinite.]; (أربى) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هي», nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; (من أمّة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أربى); (إنّما) a restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (يبلوكم) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (كم) is a pronoun, direct object; (الله) the Name of Majesty, agent, nominative; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يبلوكم); (الواو) resumptive; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (يبيّننّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative, and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو», i.e. Allah; (لكم) like «عليكم», attached to (يبيّننّ); (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يبيّننّ); (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as direct object; (فيه) like «به», attached to (تختلفون); (كنتم) a defective past verb and its noun; (تختلفون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent..
The clause «لا تكونوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «لا تنقضوا..».
The clause «نقضت ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (التي).
The clause «تتّخذون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun of «تكونوا».
The clause «تكون أمّة ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تكون..) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. «لأن تكون..», and the preposition is attached to the verb «تتّخذون».
The clause «هي أربى ...» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «تكون».
The clause «يبلوكم الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يبيّننّ لكم» has no grammatical position: the answer to an implied oath.
The clause «كنتم فيه تختلفون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «تختلفون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كنتم».

* Morphology:
(توكيد): the regular maṣdar (verbal noun) of the four-letter verb «وكّد»; its pattern is تفعيل.
(كفيلا): an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from «كفل يكفل», of the bāb «فرح»; its pattern is فعيل.
(غزلها): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the triliteral verb «غزل»; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(أنكاثا): plural of «نكث», meaning «منكوث», i.e. "undone"; and «النكث» is with kasra on the nūn, like «حمل» and «أحمال».
(دخلا): a noun for what enters into a thing and is not part of it, i.e. a defect; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(أربى): an elative noun (ism tafḍīl) from «ربا يربو»; its pattern is أفعل, and in it there is a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by substitution; its origin is «أربي» — with fatḥa on the bāʾ — the yāʾ, vowelled after a fatḥa, was changed into an alif, and it is written in the form of a yāʾ because it is the fourth letter, its origin being a wāw.

* Benefits:
- The parable (mathal) in the Qur'an:
We alluded to this Quranic characteristic earlier, and we return to speak about it because of its importance in conveying the message and delivering the call.
It seems that Allah preferred this style of striking parables over others because He, glorified be He, knows the effect it has on the hearts and minds of the listeners.
There comes to mind here the method of the Messiah, upon him be peace, in conveying his message: he took the parable as one of his major means, and he would relate parables to his disciples and followers. It seems that this style took hold of people's hearts, so they would ask him for more of it, listen to him and benefit from what they heard.. We hardly find a sura in the Noble Qur'an in which there do not occur parables that dazzle and render incapable.
Let us listen to the Exalted in this verse when He says: «وَلا تَكُونُوا كَالَّتِي نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَها مِنْ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنْكاثاً».
In it there is wisdom, a lesson, and an affirmation. As for the science of rhetoric, the parable is a representational simile (tashbīh tamthīlī), because the point of similarity in it is drawn from several attributes.

safi-cedvel:93-93.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (شاء) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (اللام) connecting the apodosis; (جعلكم) like «شاء», and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the agent is «هو»; (أمّة) a second direct object, accusative; (واحدة) a naʿt (adjective) of «أمّة», accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk); (يضلّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is «هو»; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as direct object; (يشاء) like «يضلّ»; (الواو) conjunction; (يهدي من يشاء) like its counterpart; (الواو) conjunction; (اللام) the lām of the oath; (تسألنّ) an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the retention of the nūn, which has been dropped because of the succession of identical letters, and the wāw — dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents — is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis; (عن) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تسألنّ) [Note: Or it is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive, attached to (تسألنّ).]. (كنتم تعملون) like «كنتم تختلفون» [Note: In verse (92) of this sura.].
The clause «شاء ... الله» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «جعلكم....» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يضلّ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (من).
The clause «يهدي ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «يضلّ».
The (second) clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (من).
The clause «تسألنّ ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the implied oath.
The clause «كنتم تعملون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «تعملون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of «كنتم».

safi-cedvel:94-96.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لا تتّخذوا.. بينكم): the i'rab of its counterpart has passed [Note: In verse (91) of this sura.]. (الفاء) the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya); (تزلّ) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the fāʾ; (قدم) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تزلّ); (ثبوتها) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تزلّ ...) is in the position of nominative, conjoined to an implied preceding maṣdar, i.e. "let there not be from you a taking of oaths, and so a slipping of a foot".
(الواو) conjunction; تذوقوا [Translator's note: so in the source, without parentheses] an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (تزلّ), and the sign of the accusative is the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent; (السوء) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (صددتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn..
and (تم) is the agent; (عن سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (صددتم); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما صددتم..) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (تذوقوا).
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar (predicate); (عذاب) a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (عظيم) a naʿt (adjective) of «عذاب», nominative.
The clause «لا تتّخذوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive. [Translator's note: the source reads «جملة: «جملة لا تتّخذوا ...»», repeating the word «جملة».]
The clause «تزلّ قدم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «تذوقوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause that is the ṣila of the particle relative.
The clause «صددتم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «لكم عذاب ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
(الواو) conjunction; (لا تشتروا) like «لا تنقضوا» «1»; (بعهد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تشتروا) by its being made to carry the meaning of «تستبدلوا» ("exchange"); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (ثمنا) direct object, accusative; (قليلا) a naʿt of (ثمنا), accusative; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as the noun (ism) of «إنّ» «2»; [Translator's note: the footnote markers «1» and «2» appear in the source, but their footnote texts are not included in this entry.] (عند) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila of «ما»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, like the first; (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (خير) khabar, nominative; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (خير); (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (كنتم) a defective past verb, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) is a pronoun, the noun of «كان»; (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «لا تشتروا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «لا تتّخذوا..».
The clause «إنّ ما عند الله ...» has no grammatical position: giving a reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «هو خير لكم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of «إنّ».
The clause «كنتم تعلمون» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تعلمون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كنتم».
(ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (عندكم) like the first, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ينفد) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is «هو», and it is the referring pronoun; (الواو) conjunction; (ما عند الله) like «ما عندكم»; (باق) the khabar of the second «ما», nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the dropped yāʾ, as it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ); (الواو) conjunction; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (نجزينّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative.. and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and the agent is "we", for majesty; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as direct object; (صبروا) a past verb and its agent; (أجرهم) a second direct object, accusative, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (بأحسن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نجزينّ); (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive, and the referring pronoun is omitted, and the clause is the ṣila.]; (كانوا يعملون) like «كنتم تعملون» [Note: In verse (93) of this sura.].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا..) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ما عندكم ينفد ...» has no grammatical position: in the status of giving a reason for what preceded.
The clause «ينفد ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of «ما».
The clause «ما عند الله باق» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the reason-giving clause «ما عندكم».
The clause «نجزينّ ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the implied oath.
The clause «صبروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «كانوا يعملون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «يعملون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كانوا».

* Morphology:
(باق): active participle from the triliteral (بقي); its pattern is فاع; its final radical (lām) has been dropped in keeping with the nunation, so it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ).

* Rhetoric:
1- Representational metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya): in the words of the Exalted «فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِها». The speech is a metaphor for falling into a grave matter, because when the foot slips, a person is overturned from a state of good to a state of evil.
(2) And in the words of the Exalted «فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِها»:
The singular and indefinite form of «القدم»: the secret in that is to regard as grave that a single foot should slip from the path of truth after it had been firm upon it — so how about many feet?

safi-cedvel:2-2.t:
* I'rab:
(ينزّل): an imperfect verb, nominative; the agent is a latent pronoun (huwa). (الملائكة): direct object (mafʿūl bihi), accusative. (بالروح): a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl (circumstantial) from الملائكة, i.e. accompanied by revelation [Note: The interpretation of الروح has come up: revelation, the Qur'an, the spirits of creatures, mercy, guidance, Jibrīl, etc.]. (من أمره): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to a ḥāl from الروح [Note: or attached to (ينزّل), with من denoting partitiveness.], and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (على): a preposition. (من): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) in the position of a genitive, attached to (ينزّل). (يشاء): like ينزّل. (من عباده): a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl from the relative noun, and (الهاء) is the muḍāf ilayhi. (أن): a maṣdar particle [Note: or a particle of explanation, because the sending down is a revelation that contains the sense of speech, though not its letters.]. (أنذروا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn, and (الواو) is the agent. (أنّ): a particle of emphasis and accusative, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the accusative, the noun of anna. (لا): the lā of generic negation. (إله): the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of the accusative; the khabar of lā is omitted, its implied form being "موجود" ("existent"). (إلّا): a particle of exception. (أنا): a detached pronoun, indeclinable in the position of the nominative, badal (substitute) for the latent pronoun in the khabar.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أنذروا ... ) is in the position of the genitive, badal for الروح.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّه لا إله إلّا أنا..) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. "بأنه لا إله إلّا أنا..", attached to (أنذروا..).
(الفاء): linking the apodosis of an implied condition. (اتّقون): like أنذروا, and (النون) is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and (الياء), which is omitted, is the direct object.
The clause «ينزّل ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «يشاء ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «أنذروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «لا إله إلّا أنا» is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of anna.
The clause «اتّقون» has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if the matter is as mentioned, with the angels descending upon the prophets, then fear Me" [Note: or: "if you wish salvation in the Hereafter, then fear Me through My oneness."].

safi-cedvel:3-3.t:
* I'rab:
(خلق): a past verb; the agent is a latent pronoun (huwa). (السموات): direct object, accusative, its accusative marker being the kasra. (الأرض): conjoined (maʿṭūf) with السموات by the wāw, accusative. (بالحقّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl from the agent of خلق. (تعالى عمّا يشركون): its i'rab has been given before [Note: in verse (1) of this sūra.].
The clause «خلق ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause «تعالى ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause «يشركون ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun or of the particle-relative (ما).

safi-cedvel:115-115.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّما) kāffa (restrictive) and makfūfa (restricted) [Translator's note: i.e. inna with the redundant mā that restrains it from governing] (حرّم) a past verb, and the agent is "he" (هو) (على) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (حرّم), (الميتة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (الواو) a conjunction in all four places (الدم، لحم) two nouns conjoined to الميتة, accusative (الخنزير) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, conjoined to الميتة by the wāw (أهلّ) a past passive verb, indeclinable, and the deputy agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he", and it is the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) (لغير) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أهلّ) (الله) the sacred Name, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أهلّ) [Note: or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the deputy agent, i.e. "offered in sacrifice with it".] (الفاء) a conjunction (من) a conditional noun that jussively governs, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject) (اضطرّ) a past passive verb, indeclinable, in the position of the jussive, being the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the deputy agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (غير) ḥāl, accusative (باغ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the implied kasra on the omitted yāʾ (الواو) a conjunction (لا) redundant, to emphasise the negation (عاد) like باغ and conjoined to it (الفاء) a linking fāʾ, or one of causation (إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative (الله) the sacred Name, the noun of inna, accusative (غفور) khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (رحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «إنّما حرّم ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «أهلّ لغير ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «من اضطرّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive.
The clause «اضطرّ ... » is in the position of the nominative, as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: it is permissible that the khabar be the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis together.].
The clause «إنّ الله غفور» has no grammatical position; it gives the reason for the implied apodosis, i.e.: "so there is no sin upon him, for Allah is Forgiving…"

* Benefits:
- His saying, the Exalted: ﴿فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ باغٍ وَلا عادٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾.
The jurists said, in substance: if famine befalls a people so that they are on the verge of perishing, and they find nothing to sustain them except one of the prohibited things mentioned in the verse just cited, there is no sin upon them in partaking of what has been explicitly forbidden, provided that they do not take too much of it. They take only what rescues them from destruction; they do not hoard, nor store up, nor keep for themselves, nor add beyond necessity. This is the meaning of his saying: "neither desiring nor transgressing".

safi-cedvel:116-117.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (لا) a prohibitive that governs the jussive (تقولوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and (الواو) is the agent (اللام) a preposition (ما) a maṣdar (verbal noun) particle [Note: or a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the lām, with the returning pronoun omitted, i.e. "which it describes", the clause after it being the ṣila of ما.] (تصف) an imperfect verb, nominative (ألسنتكم) agent, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (الكذب) mafʿūl bihi, whose governor is تصف, accusative [Note: it is permissible that it be a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, i.e. "do not say the false saying"; and it is permissible that it be a mafʿūl bihi of "saying".].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تصف ألسنتكم..) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (تقولوا), and the (اللام) is for giving a reason.
(ها) a particle of alerting (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ (حلال) khabar, nominative (الواو) a conjunction (هذا حرام) like هذا حلال (اللام) for giving a reason (تفتروا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and (الواو) is the agent (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تفتروا) (الكذب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تفتروا) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and it is a badal (substitute) for the first interpreted maṣdar, with the preposition repeated.
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb (a governing particle) (الّذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, the noun of inna (يفترون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو) is the agent (على الله الكذب) like the first (لا) negative (يفلحون) like يفترون.
The clause «لا تقولوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «تصف ألسنتكم ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-type relative (ما).
The clause «هذا حلال ... » is in the position of the accusative, as the reported speech (maqūl al-qawl) [Note: it is in the position of the accusative as a badal of الكذب, if الكذب is parsed as a mafʿūl bihi of the verb تقولوا.].
The clause «هذا حرام ... » is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause of the reported speech.
The clause «تفتروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the implied particle-type relative (أن).
The clause «إنّ الّذين ... » has no grammatical position; it gives a reason.
The clause «لا يفلحون» is in the position of the nominative, as khabar of inna.
The clause «يفترون ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الّذين).
(متاع) mubtadaʾ, nominative, its khabar omitted and put first, i.e. "for them is an enjoyment" [Note: or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "their living", or "their benefit", or "their remaining… is an enjoyment".] (قليل) naʿt (adjective) of متاع, nominative (الواو) a conjunction (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to the fronted khabar (عذاب) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative (أليم) naʿt of عذاب, nominative.
The clause « (لهم) متاع ... » has no grammatical position; it gives a reason.
The clause «لهم عذاب ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the explanatory clause.

* Rhetoric:
- Istiʿāra bi-l-kināya (metaphor by implication): in His saying, the Exalted: ﴿لِما تَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُكُمُ الْكَذِبَ﴾ — as if their tongues, being the source of falsehood and the spring of untruth, were a person who knows its essence and encompasses its reality, describing it to people with the clearest description and defining it with the plainest definition, in the manner of istiʿāra bi-l-kināya, as it is said: "his face describes beauty" and "his eye describes magic". It is among the eloquent and most expressive speech.

* Benefits:
Ibn Hishām commented on this verse by saying: It has been said regarding ﴿وَلا تَقُولُوا لِما تَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُكُمُ الْكَذِبَ﴾ and regarding ﴿كَما أَرْسَلْنا فِيكُمْ رَسُولًا مِنْكُمْ﴾ that الكذب is a badal of the omitted object of تصف, i.e. "of what it describes"; and likewise رسولا, on the basis that the «ما» in «كما» is a relative noun. This is refuted by the fact that it would apply ما to a single one of those possessing intellect. The apparent view is that ما is kāffa (restraining); and more apparent than that is that it is maṣdarī (a maṣdar particle), so that the kāf remains operative in the genitive. It has also been said of الكذب that it is a mafʿūl of تقولوا and that the two clauses after it are a badal of it, i.e. "do not say the falsehood, because of what your tongues describe of animals as lawful and forbidden"; or (it is) for an omitted verb, i.e. "so you say the falsehood"; or for تصف, with ما being maṣdarī and the two clauses being the quoted speech, i.e. "do not declare lawful and forbidden merely on a saying your tongues utter".

safi-cedvel:118-119.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (على) a preposition (الّذين) a relative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to (حرّمنا) (هادوا) a past verb and its agent (حرّمنا) a past verb and its agent (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, mafʿūl bihi (قصصنا) like حرّمنا (على) like the first (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (قصصنا) (من) a preposition (قبل) a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive, attached to (قصصنا) [Note: it has also been said: attached to (حرّمنا).] (الواو) a conjunction — or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) (ما) negative (ظلمناهم) like حرّمنا, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (الواو) a conjunction (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk) (كانوا) an incomplete past verb (kāna), and its noun (أنفسهم) a fronted mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi (يظلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «هادوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الّذين).
The clause «حرّمنا ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «قصصنا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «ما ظلمناهم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive [Note: or it is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the agent pronoun in (حرّمنا).
(3, 4) In verse (110) of this sura.].
The clause «كانوا ... يظلمون» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to ما ظلمناهم.
The clause «يظلمون» is in the position of the accusative, as khabar of كانوا.
(ثمّ) a conjunction (إنّ ربّك.. السوء) its i'rab has already been given «3», (السوء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (بجهالة) a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl from the agent of عملوا (ثمّ) like the first (تابوا) a verb like هادوا (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تابوا) (ذلك) the demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.. and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address (الواو) a conjunction (أصلحوا) like هادوا (إنّ ربّك.. رحيم) its i'rab has already been given «4».
The clause «إنّ ربّك للذين ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause حرّمنا ...
The clause «عملوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «تابوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أصلحوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause تابوا.
The clause «إنّ ربّك.. لغفور ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive, corroborating the first.

* Benefits:
1- من قبل: قبل is an adverb of time, indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is annexed to a muḍāf ilayhi that is omitted in the utterance but present to the mind. The discussion of «قبل and بعد» has already preceded, so there is no need to repeat it.
2- السوء: the hamza is written on the line, because it occurs at the end of the word and is preceded by a sākin (a letter without a vowel). We have already given an additional discussion of the hamza and its writing in all its cases; so return to it in its place.

safi-cedvel:4-8.t:
* I'rab:
(خلق الإنسان): like خلق السموات [Note: in the preceding verse (3).]. (من نطفة): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (خلق). (الفاء): conjunctive. (إذا): the particle of surprise. (هو): a detached pronoun, indeclinable in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject). (خصيم): khabar (predicate), nominative. (مبين): naʿt (adjective) of خصيم, nominative.
The clause «خلق ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause «هو خصيم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive clause.
(الواو): conjunctive. (الأنعام): direct object of an omitted verb by way of ishtighāl (preoccupation), which the following verb explains, i.e. "He created the cattle". (خلقها): like the first, and (ها) is a pronoun, direct object, and the agent is a latent pronoun (huwa). (اللام): a preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (خلقها) [Note: It is permissible to pause at the words خلقها, in which case (لكم) is attached to a preposed khabar for دفء, and this agrees with verse 6 below ... and it is permissible for (لكم) to be a ḥāl from دفء, with (فيها) as the khabar..]. (في): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a preposed khabar. (دفء): postposed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (منافع): conjoined with دفء by the wāw, nominative. (الواو): conjunctive. (فيها): like منها, attached to (تأكلون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause « (خلق) الأنعام ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause خلق الإنسان.
And the clause «خلقها ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause «فيها دفء ... » has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the hāʾ in (خلقها).].
And the clause «منها تأكلون» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause فيها دفء.
(الواو): conjunctive. (لكم فيها جمال): like لكم فيها دفء, a preposed khabar and a postposed mubtadaʾ [Note: It is permissible for (لكم) to be a ḥāl from جمال, the governing factor in it being the sense of settledness.]. (حين): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to جمال [Note: or attached to an adjective of جمال.]. (تريحون): like تأكلون. (الواو): conjunctive. (حين تسرحون): like حين تريحون.
And the clause «لكم فيها جمال ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause فيها دفء.
And the clause «تريحون ... » is in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause «تسرحون» is in the position of the genitive, by the annexation of the second حين to it.
(الواو): conjunctive. (تحمل): an imperfect verb, nominative; the agent is "she", i.e. the cattle. (أثقالكم): direct object, accusative.. and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إلى بلد): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (تحمل). (لم): a particle of negation and jussive. (تكونوا): a defective imperfect verb, jussive, its jussive marker being the omission of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the noun of تكون. (بالغيه): khabar, accusative, its accusative marker being the yāʾ ... and (الهاء) is the muḍāf ilayhi. (إلّا): a particle of restriction. (بشقّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, ḥāl from the latent pronoun in بالغيه. (الأنفس): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb. (ربّكم): the noun of inna, accusative.. and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (اللام): the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). (رؤف): the khabar of inna, nominative. (رحيم): a second khabar, nominative.
And the clause «تحمل ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause فيها دفء.
And the clause «لم تكونوا بالغيه ... » is in the position of the genitive, naʿt of بلد.
And the clause «إنّ ربّكم لرؤوف ... » has no grammatical position; it is a causal resumption (istiʾnāf taʿlīlī).
(الواو): conjunctive. (الخيل): like الأنعام [Note: It is permissible for it to be conjoined to الأنعام and accusative like it.]. (الواو): conjunctive in the four places. (البغال، الحمير): two nouns conjoined to الخيل, accusative like it. (اللام): for causation. (تركبوها): an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, its accusative marker being the omission of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent, and (ها) is a pronoun, direct object.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تركبوها ... ) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to the implied verb خلق.
(زينة): mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative, conjoined to the position of the interpreted maṣdar [Note: or an absolute object (mafʿūl muṭlaq) of an omitted verb: "adorn yourselves with them with an adornment".]. (تخلق): like تحمل, and the agent is a latent pronoun (huwa). (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of the accusative, direct object [Note: or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, in the position of the accusative, with the clause after it as its naʿt.]; the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. "تعلمونه". (لا): negative. (تعلمون): like تأكلون.
And the clause « (خلق) الخيل ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause (خلق) الأنعام.
And the clause «يخلق ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause (خلق) الخيل [Note: It is permissible for the clause to be resumptive.].
And the clause «تعلمون» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).

* Morphology:
(الإنسان): a well-known noun. Its origin is إنسيان, because the Arabs, all of them, said in its diminutive أنيسيان, so the final yāʾ indicated the yāʾ in its non-diminutive form, except that they dropped it when it became frequent in their speech. Its plural is الناس. When they say أناسين it is a clear plural like بستان and بساتين, and when they say أناسيّ often, lightening the yāʾ, they drop the yāʾ that falls between the ʿayn and the lām of the verb. What shows that أناسي, lightened, is permissible is the Arabs' saying أناسية كثيرة. The singular is إنسيّ and أناس. The wazn of إنسيان is إفعلان (with kasra on the hamza), from النسيان (forgetfulness); the yāʾ was dropped and it was said إنسان.. And see verse (8) of sūrat al-Baqara.
(نطفة): a noun for the fluid of man and woman. Its plural is نطف (with ḍamma and fatḥa) and نطاف (with ḍamma on the nūn). According to Abū Zayd, نطفة has no verb.
(دفء): in al-Mukhtār: al-dif' is the produce of camels and what is benefited from, so it is a noun; and it is warmth, a noun from دفئ يدفأ (the pattern of طرب and سلم). The masculine is دفئان and the feminine دفأى.
In al-Miṣbāḥ: the active participle is not said as دفيء on the pattern of كريم, but on the pattern of تعب. In al-Qāmūs: al-dif' with kasra, and also with a vowel on the second letter, is the opposite of the severity of cold. Its wazn is فعل (kasra then sukūn).
(جمال): maṣdar of جمل يجمل (the pattern of كرم). Its wazn is فعال (fatḥa on the fāʾ and the ʿayn).
(أثقال): plural of ثقل, a noun for the traveller's baggage. Its wazn is فعل (two fatḥas), and أثقال is on the wazn أفعال.
(بلد): a noun on the wazn فعل (two fatḥas). Its plural is بلاد and بلدان.
(شقّ): a noun for half of a thing, and the meaning is figurative, i.e. they would not reach it except through a diminishing of the strength of the self and the loss of half of it. In al-Mukhtār: al-shaqq is also hardship; and it is said that the one with fatḥa is the verbal noun and the one with kasra is the noun. Its wazn is فعل (kasra then sukūn).
(الخيل): see verse (14) of sūrat Āl ʿImrān.
(البغال): plural of بغل, a noun for the animal born between horses and donkeys. Its wazn is فعل (fatḥa then sukūn).
(الحمير): plural of الحمار, a noun for the well-known animal. Its wazn is فعال (kasra on the fāʾ). It is also pluralised as أحمرة (fatḥa on the hamza and kasra on the mīm), حمر (two ḍammas), حمور (ḍamma on the ḥāʾ) and حمرات (two ḍammas). Its feminine is with tāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
- Preposing (taqdīm): in His saying, Exalted is He, حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ — the bringing home (al-irāḥa) is mentioned before the sending out to pasture (al-sarḥ), although in existence it comes after it, because it is more evident than it in bringing about the beauty mentioned, and more complete in attracting familiarity and delight, since in it there is presence after absence, and approach after turning away, in the best of states, with bellies full and udders swollen.

safi-cedvel:9-9.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (على الله): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted preposed khabar. (قصد): postposed mubtadaʾ, with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "the clarification of the straight course of the way". (السبيل): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو): parenthetical. (من): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a preposed khabar. (جائر): postposed mubtadaʾ, nominative; originally it is an adjective of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "a deviating way". (الواو): conjunctive. (لو): a non-jussive conditional particle. (شاء): a past verb; the agent is a latent pronoun (huwa) and its object is omitted, i.e. "your guidance". (اللام): occurring in the apodosis of لو. (هداكم): a past verb, indeclinable on an implied fatḥa on the alif.. and (كم) is a pronoun, direct object, and the agent is a latent pronoun (huwa). (أجمعين): tawkīd (emphasis) of the second-person pronoun in (هداكم), accusative, its accusative marker being the yāʾ [Note: or a ḥāl from the mentioned pronoun, accusative.].
The clause «على الله قصد ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause «منها جائر ... » has no grammatical position; it is parenthetical.
And the clause «شاء ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive.
And the clause «هداكم ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

* Morphology:
(قصد): maṣdar of قصد meaning setting straight the way or making the way even, and it is not the maṣdar of (قصدته) meaning "I came to him". It is a maṣdar that is used as a description.. One says سبيل قصد meaning قاصد, i.e. straight, as though it aims at the direction that the traveller heads for and does not swerve from. Its wazn is فعل (fatḥa then sukūn).
(جائر): active participle of جار يجوز, i.e. deviated from straightness. Its wazn is فاعل, and in it the weak letter wāw was replaced by a hamza because it came after the alif of فاعل; and this is the case of the active participle of every hollow weak verb.

safi-cedvel:120-123.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative (إبراهيم) the noun of inna, accusative; it is prevented from tanwīn (nunation) because it is a proper name and foreign (ʿujma) (كان) an incomplete past verb (kāna), and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (أمّة) khabar of كان, accusative (قانتا) a second khabar, accusative (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قانتا) (حنيفا) a third khabar, accusative (الواو) a conjunction (لم) a particle of negation and jussive (يك) an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the overt sukūn on the nūn, which is dropped for lightness, and its noun is "he" (من المشركين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of يك.
The clause «إنّ إبراهيم كان ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «كان أمّة ... » is in the position of the nominative, as khabar of inna.
The clause «لم يك ... » is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause كان أمّة.
(شاكرا) another khabar of كان, accusative (لأنعمه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (شاكرا).. and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (اجتباه) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied fatḥa on the alif.. and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the agent is "he" (الواو) a conjunction (هداه) like اجتباه (إلى صراط) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (هداه) (مستقيم) naʿt of صراط, genitive.
The clause «اجتباه ... » has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «هداه ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause اجتباه.
(الواو) a conjunction (آتيناه) a verb indeclinable on sukūn.. and (نا) is the pronoun of the agent, and (الهاء) is mafʿūl bihi (في الدّنيا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from حسنة — an adjective that has been put before the one it describes — [Note: or attached to (آتيناه).], the sign of the genitive being the implied kasra on the alif (حسنة) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (الواو) a conjunction (إنّه) a particle resembling the verb, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the accusative, the noun of inna (في الآخرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to الصالحين (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis (من الصّالحين) a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar of inna.
The clause «آتيناه ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause اجتباه.
The clause «إنّه في الآخرة ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause آتيناه.
(ثمّ) a conjunction (أوحينا) like آتينا (إلى) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أوحينآ) (أن) a particle of explanation «1» (اتّبع) an imperative verb, and the agent is "you" (ملّة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (إبراهيم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa [Translator's note: because it is a diptote] (حنيفا) ḥāl from إبراهيم, accusative (الواو) a conjunction (ما) negative (كان) an incomplete past verb, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (من المشركين) a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar of كان.
The clause «أوحينآ ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause آتيناه.
The clause «اتّبع ... » has no grammatical position; it is explicative.
The clause «ما كان من المشركين» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl (حنيفا).

* Benefits:
- The ḥāl comes from the muḍāf ilayhi if it is in one of the following cases:
a- that the muḍāf is a part of the muḍāf ilayhi, as in ﴿ونزعنا ما في صدورهم من غل إخوانا﴾.
b- or that it resembles a part of the muḍāf ilayhi, as in the verse ﴿اتَّبِعْ مِلَّةَ إِبْراهِيمَ حَنِيفاً﴾.
c- that the muḍāf is the governor of the ḥāl, as in ﴿إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعاً﴾.

safi-cedvel:124-124.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّما) kāffa and makfūfa (جعل) a past passive verb (السبت) deputy agent (على الذين) a preposition and its genitive noun, whose i'rab has been given [Note: in verse (118) of this sura], attached to (جعل), by its being given the sense of "was imposed" (اختلفوا) a past verb and its agent (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (اختلفوا) (الواو) a conjunction (إنّ ربّك) like إنّ إبراهيم [Note: in verse (120) of this sura], and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (اللام) the shifted lām, for emphasis (يحكم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is "he" (بينهم) an adverb, accusative, attached to (يحكم) ..
and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يحكم) (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (في) a preposition and (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (يحكم) (كانوا.. يختلفون) like كانوا يظلمون [Note: in verse (118) of this sura]. (فيه) like the first, attached to (يختلفون).
The clause «جعل السّبت ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «اختلفوا فيه ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الّذين).
The clause «إنّ ربّك ليحكم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive.
The clause «يحكم ... » is in the position of the nominative, as khabar of inna.
The clause «كانوا ... يختلفون» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يختلفون» is in the position of the accusative, as khabar of كانوا.

safi-cedvel:125-128.t:
* I'rab:
(ادع) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and the agent is "you" (إلى سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb ادع (ربّك) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (بالحكمة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from the agent of ادع (الواو) a conjunction (الموعظة) conjoined to الحكمة, genitive (الحسنة) naʿt of الموعظة, genitive (الواو) a conjunction (جادلهم) like ادع, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (الباء) a preposition (الّتي) a relative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to (جادل), and there is an omitted described noun (mawṣūf), i.e.: "with the disputation that…" (هي) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ (أحسن) khabar, nominative (إنّ ربّك) like إنّ إبراهيم [Note: in verse (120) of this sura] and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (هو) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (أعلم) khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو (الباء) a preposition (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (أعلم) (ضلّ) a past verb, and the agent is "he", and it is the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) (عن سبيله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ضلّ), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (الواو) a conjunction (هو أعلم) like the first (بالمهتدين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the second (أعلم), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «ادع ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «جادلهم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive.
The clause «هي أحسن ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الّتي).
The clause «إنّ ربّك..» has no grammatical position; it gives a reason.
The clause «هو أعلم ... » is in the position of the nominative, as khabar of inna.
The clause «ضلّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «هو أعلم (the second)» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause هو أعلم (the first).
(الواو) a conjunction (إن) a conditional particle that jussively governs (عاقبتم) a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of the jussive, being the protasis.. and (تم) is the pronoun of the agent (الفاء) linking the apodosis (عاقبوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent (بمثل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عاقبوا) (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (عوقبتم) a past passive verb.. and (تم) is a pronoun in the position of the nominative, deputy agent (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (عوقبتم) (الواو) a conjunction (اللام) the lām that prepares for an oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam) (إن صبرتم) like إن عاقبتم (اللام) the lām of the oath (هو خير) like هو أعلم (للصابرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خير), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «إن عاقبتم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive.
The clause «عاقبوا ... » is in the position of the jussive, as the apodosis, accompanied by the fāʾ.
The clause «عوقبتم به ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «إن صبرتم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause إن عاقبتم..
The clause «هو خير للصابرين» has no grammatical position; it is the response to the implied oath.. and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
(الواو) a conjunction (اصبر) like ادع (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl (circumstantial) (ما) negative (صبرك) mubtadaʾ, nominative.. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (إلّا) a particle of restriction (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ صبرك (الواو) a conjunction (لا) a prohibitive that governs the jussive (تحزن) an imperfect verb, jussive, and the agent is "you" (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (تحزن) (الواو) a conjunction (لا تك) like لا تحزن, the verb being an incomplete imperfect, the sign of the jussive being the sukūn on the nūn, which is dropped for lightness, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you" (في ضيق) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of تك (من) a preposition (ما) a maṣdar particle [Note: or a relative noun in the position of the genitive, with the returning pronoun omitted.] (يمكرون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يمكرون) is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, attached to (ضيق).
The clause «اصبر ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause إن عاقبتم ...
The clause «ما صبرك إلّا بالله» is in the position of the accusative, as a ḥāl from the agent of اصبر.
The clause «لا تحزن ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause اصبر.
The clause «لا تك في ضيق..» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause لا تحزن.
The clause «يمكرون» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-type relative (ما).
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb (الله) the sacred Name, the noun of inna, accusative (مع) an adverb, accusative, attached to the khabar of inna (الّذين) a relative, in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (اتّقوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied ḍamma on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two sākin letters.. and (الواو) is the agent (الواو) a conjunction (الّذين) like the first and conjoined to it (هم محسنون) like (هم) ظالمون [Note: in verse (113) of this sura].
The clause «إنّ الله مع ... » has no grammatical position; it gives a reason.
The clause «اتّقوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الّذين).
The clause «هم محسنون» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (the second الّذين).

safi-cedvel:10-10.t:
* I'rab:
(هو): a detached pronoun, indeclinable in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ. (الذي): a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of the nominative, khabar. (أنزل): a past verb; the agent is a latent pronoun (huwa). (من السماء): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (أنزل) [Note: or ḥāl from ماء..]. (ما): direct object, accusative. (اللام): a preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a preposed khabar [Note: It is sound to pause at (لكم), in which case it is a naʿt of ماء, and (ومنه) is a preposed khabar for the mubtadaʾ شراب.]. (من): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a ḥāl from شراب. (شراب): postposed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (الواو): conjunctive. (منه شجر): like منه شراب, and conjoined to it. (فيه): like منه, attached to the verb (تسيمون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «هو الذي ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause «أنزل ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي).
And the clause «لكم منه شراب» is in the position of the accusative, naʿt of ماء [Note: or it is resumptive with no grammatical position, to explain the benefit of the water; so it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).].
And the clause «تسيمون» is in the position of the nominative, naʿt of شجر.

* Morphology:
(شجر): a collective noun whose singular is شجرة. It is whatever of the plants of the earth stands upon a stem. The plural of شجر is أشجار and شجراء, and the plural of شجرة is شجرات. The wazn of شجر is فعل (two fatḥas).

safi-cedvel:11-13.t:
* I'rab:
(ينبت): an imperfect verb, nominative; the agent is a latent pronoun (huwa). (لكم): attached to (ينبت). (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (ينبت); the bāʾ is causal, and the pronoun refers back to the water. (الزرع): direct object, accusative. (الواو): conjunctive in the four places. (الزيتون، النخيل، الأعناب): nouns conjoined to الزرع by conjunctions, accusative like it. (من كلّ): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an adjective of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "and something of every ..."; and من is partitive. (الثمرات): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb, a naskh particle. (في): a preposition. (ذلك): a demonstrative, indeclinable in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted khabar of inna.. and (اللام) denotes distance, and (الكاف) is for address. (اللام) the second: for emphasis. (آية): the postposed noun of inna, accusative. (لقوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, naʿt of آية. (يتفكّرون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent.
The clause «ينبت ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause «إنّ في ذلك لآية ... » has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption.
And the clause «يتفكّرون» is in the position of the genitive, naʿt of قوم.
(الواو): conjunctive. (سخّر): a past verb; the agent is a latent pronoun (huwa). (لكم): attached to (سخّر). (الليل): direct object, accusative. (الواو): conjunctive in the four places. (النهار، الشمس، القمر،): nouns conjoined to الليل, accusative like it. (النجوم): mubtadaʾ, nominative. (مسخّرات): khabar, nominative. (بأمره): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مسخّرات ...
and (الهاء) is the muḍāf ilayhi. (إنّ في ... يعقلون): like إنّ في.. يتفكّرون, and the accusative marker of آيات is the kasra.
The clause «سخّر ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause ينبت.
And the clause «النجوم مسخّرات ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause سخّر.
And the clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات ... » has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption.
And the clause «يعقلون» is in the position of the genitive, naʿt of قوم.
(الواو): conjunctive. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable in the position of the accusative, direct object of an omitted verb, i.e. "He subjected to you what ..." [Note: It is permissible for it to be conjoined by the wāw to الليل, in which case it is a conjunction of singular words, with no clause.]. (ذرأ): a past verb; the agent is a latent pronoun (huwa). (لكم): attached to (ذرأ). (في الأرض): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (ذرأ). (مختلفا): an accusative ḥāl from the returning pronoun, i.e. "what He has multiplied for you, varying". (ألوانه): the agent of the active participle مختلفا.. and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إنّ في.. يذّكّرون): like إنّ في..
يتفكّرون.
And the clause « (سخّر) ما ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause سخّر لكم الليل.
And the clause «ذرأ لكم ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
And the clause «إنّ في ذلك لآية ... » has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption.
And the clause «يذّكّرون» is in the position of the genitive, naʿt of قوم.

safi-cedvel:14-16.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (هو): a detached pronoun, indeclinable in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ. (الذي): a relative noun in the position of the nominative, khabar. (سخّر البحر): like سخّر الليل [Note: in verse (12) of this sūra.].
(اللام): for causation. (تأكلوا): an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, its accusative marker being the omission of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the agent. (من): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (تأكلوا) with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "from its animals" [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl from (لحما), a naʿt that has been preposed before the qualified noun.]. (لحما): direct object, accusative. (طريّا): naʿt of (لحما), accusative. (الواو): conjunctive. (تستخرجوا): like تأكلوا, and conjoined to it. (منه): like the first, attached to (تستخرجوا). (حلية): direct object, accusative. (تلبسونها): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and (الواو) is the agent, and (ها) is a pronoun, direct object. (الواو): parenthetical. (ترى): an imperfect verb, nominative, its nominative marker being the ḍamma implied on the alif; the agent is "you". (الفلك): direct object, accusative. (مواخر): an accusative ḥāl. (فيه): like منه, attached to مواخر. (الواو): conjunctive. (لتبتغوا): like لتأكلوا. (من فضله): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (تبتغوا). (الواو): conjunctive. (لعلّكم): a particle of hope and accusative.. and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of the accusative, the noun of laʿalla. (تشكرون): like تلبسون.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تأكلوا..) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (سخّر).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تبتغوا ... ) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (سخّر) because it is conjoined to it.
The clause «هو الذي ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive [Note: or it is conjoined by the wāw to an earlier resumptive.].
And the clause «سخّر البحر ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي).
And the clause «تأكلوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن) that is implied.
And the clause «تستخرجوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause تأكلوا.
And the clause «تلبسونها ... » is in the position of the accusative, naʿt of حلية.
And the clause «ترى الفلك ... » has no grammatical position; it is parenthetical.
